However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.

</details>


### [233] [Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01821)
*Tido Specht,Elias Benedict Krey,Nils Neukirch,Nils Strodthoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将NLMCD方法迁移至LLM token级激活，将概念建模为低维流形，并提出概念对齐(CBA)分数，比较不同层与模型间的概念流形，得到六项关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性(MI)方法依赖强线性假设，而证据表明特征存在非线性流形，故需超越线性概念以刻画LLM内部token表示的几何组织。

Method: 将计算机视觉中的非线性多维概念发现(NLMCD)适配到LLM token级激活，概念建模为低维流形；提出概念对齐(CBA)分数——一种广义Rand指数，无需显式特征匹配即可度量几何邻近性。

Result: (i)CBA比PCA/CKA线性基线更敏感；(ii)层间对齐矩阵揭示中间层与后层的两个块结构；(iii)概念组成多数网络以句法主导，后期转向句法-语义混合并趋于输出导向；(iv)英汉多语共享依赖训练，Qwen最强、Llama较弱、GPT-2无；(v)同族Qwen跨规模强对齐，跨族弱；(vi)Tulu-3相邻训练阶段对齐最高，base→SFT变化最大，DPO/RLVR后早期层基本不变，RLVR大体保留DPO晚期概念。

Conclusion: 非线性流形视角与CBA指标能揭示线性方法掩盖的层间与跨模型概念结构，为LLM内部表示几何组织与训练动态提供更细粒度刻画。

Abstract: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

</details>


### [234] [SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02182)
*Joohwan Ko,Tetiana Parshakova,Diana Cai,Robert M. Gower*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SoftServe 是一类无需线搜索和曲率修正的拟牛顿方法，通过变分目标导出正定曲率估计，并结合对角/克罗内克分解变体与 Newton-Schulz 迭代，实现对大规模神经网络的稳定扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拟牛顿方法在大规模无约束凸优化中历来是最有效的方法之一，但两大障碍限制了其在深度学习中的应用：目标函数的非凸性以及超大的参数量。现有方法通常需要线搜索或针对负曲率的临时修正，难以直接扩展到大规模神经网络。

Method: SoftServe 从 Berglund et al. (2025) 的变分目标中导出正定曲率估计，即使在存在负曲率的情况下也能保持正定。作者发展了保持正定性的对角与克罗内克分解（Kronecker-factored）两种变体，以扩展到大规模神经网络。所需矩阵运算采用稳定的耦合 Newton-Schulz 迭代，以 GPU 友好的矩阵乘法替代昂贵的矩阵分解，且无需线搜索或临时曲率修正。

Result: SoftServe 在严重病态问题上表现优异，涵盖循环网络、深度自编码器、物理信息神经网络（PINN）以及一个 136M 参数的物理信息扩散模型等任务，其损失往往低于 Adam、Muon 和 SOAP 等已有基线方法。

Conclusion: SoftServe 通过变分正定曲率估计、可扩展的分解变体以及稳定的 Newton-Schulz 迭代，克服了非凸性与大参数量两大障碍，为大规模深度学习优化提供了一类高效且无需线搜索的拟牛顿方法。

Abstract: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent networks, deep autoencoders, physics-informed neural networks, and a 136M-parameter physics-informed diffusion model, often achieving lower losses than established baselines including Adam, Muon, and SOAP.

</details>


### [235] [Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01827)
*Kevin Tirta Wijaya,Alston Lo,Michael Sun,Wojciech Matusik,Vahid Babaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISMS 提出以专家成对排序替代回归打分驱动科学设计筛选，并用 Fisher 信息准则在低/高保真排序器间选择性升级查询，在药物库筛选与开放式优化中均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算方法能在极大规模上生成候选分子与材料，但实验验证能力有限，形成"验证拥堵"。现有筛选（curation）方法多依赖预测绝对分数的数据驱动回归模型，而训练这类模型本身需要大量实验数据，成本高昂。作者观察到科学设计发现本质上是比较性的，因此成对排序信号比绝对测量更易获得，且可来自多层级保真度的专家（计算工具、经验规则、代理工作流、人类科学家）。

Method: 提出 PRISMS 框架：利用一个或多个专家提供的成对排序来识别最有前景的候选，不依赖数据饥饿的回归器。当专家在保真度与成本上存在差异时，PRISMS 依据 Fisher 信息准则，将成对查询从低保真排序器逐级升级到高保真排序器，实现选择性升级（selective escalation）与自适应查询分配。

Result: 在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中，PRISMS 以比纯回归主动学习少约 42% 的轮次、比无选择性升级的排序方法少约 15% 的轮次，达到 50% 的 top-10 发现召回率。在不限定于预定义库、需生成新设计的优化任务中，PRISMS 的超体积（hypervolume）比贝叶斯优化基线高约 18.8%。

Conclusion: 以成对排序为核心的筛选范式可绕开对大量绝对标注的依赖，兼具数据效率与实验成本优势；结合 Fisher 信息驱动的多保真度查询升级，PRISMS 在库内筛选与开放式生成优化两类任务上均显著优于回归型主动学习、纯排序方法与贝叶斯优化基线，为缓解验证拥堵提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. Here, we propose that curation can instead be primarily driven by expert pairwise rankings, which are substantially easier to gather. The expertise can come from computational tools or human input of multiple levels of fidelity, ranging from empirical rules of thumb to agentic workflows and experienced scientists. We introduce PRISMS, a framework that uses pairwise rankings from one or more experts, potentially spanning multiple levels of expertise, to identify the most promising candidates without relying on data-hungry regressors. When experts differ in fidelity and cost, PRISMS escalates pairwise queries from lower- to higher-fidelity rankers based on a Fisher-information criterion. In iterative screening that selects designs from fixed drug discovery libraries, PRISMS achieves 50% top-10 discovery recall in ~42% fewer rounds than regression-only active learning, and in ~15% fewer rounds than the ranking-based method with no selective escalation. In optimization that generates new designs without restriction to a predefined library, PRISMS achieves ~18.8% higher hypervolume than the Bayesian optimization baseline.

</details>


### [236] [Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02186)
*Yiming Huang,Yujie Zeng,Vijay Prakash Dwivedi,Simone Foti,Jianmin Wang,Jure Leskovec,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出高阶语法表示（HGR），将分子提升为组合复形并用上下文无关高阶语法解析为规则序列，从而在保持高阶拓扑表达能力的同时兼容标准序列模型，并在分子生成与表示学习任务上取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准序列与图表示难以显式编码高阶拓扑结构（如环系统和重复基序）；已有高阶表示虽能直接刻画这些结构，但计算开销大且难以解码为有效分子。同时，现有基准偏向简单环系统，存在评估偏差。

Method: 提出HGR框架：将分子提升为组合复形（combinatorial complexes），在上下文无关高阶语法下将每个复形解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，从而把高阶拓扑序列化为规则序列。另构建含118万分子的环富集基准RingDiv（含RingDiv300k子集）并提出环多样性指数（RDI）。

Result: 分子生成中，HGR模型天然保证100%有效性并具备领先的分布对齐，在全部五个生成基准的FCD上排名第一。表示学习中，HGR-FM在七项MoleculeNet基准上取得最高平均AUC，在probing与全量微调协议下分别较最强基线提升8.3与3.3 AUC点。

Conclusion: HGR是一种高效的高阶表示，兼顾分子生成与可迁移表示学习，验证了拓扑感知语法表示的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.

</details>


### [237] [Pooling Helps, Learned Weighting Hurts In-Context: Decomposing Group Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01831)
*Michael Fore,James Mason Inder,Mrishika Nair,Praneetha Vaddamanu,Sharlina Keshava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将Chronos-2的组注意力拆解为V/O（信息聚合）与Q/K（权重学习）两条通路，发现均匀池化在多数传感器网络配置中有效，而Q/K学习权重在MV上正向或中性、在ICL上显著有害；仅在首个block将α均匀化即可全面改善ICL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chronos-2提出的组注意力在固定patch索引上对同组变量做跨变量注意力，同时服务多变量（MV）与上下文学习（ICL）预测，但此前工作仅将其作为整体评估，未厘清是哪一部分机制带来收益，也未分别考察其在MV与ICL两种设定下的适用性。

Method: 在推理阶段对注意力矩阵α进行编辑，把每个head拆分为两条通路：V/O（对组内进行加权摘要并投影）与Q/K（决定权重）；据此分别构造均匀池化（仅V/O、无Q/K加权）与学习式加权两种消融，并通过逐层、逐block地均匀化α来定位不同层的影响。

Result: 均匀池化在20个传感器网络配置中有18个表现为正收益；学习式Q/K加权的贡献因组类型而异——在MV上为正或可忽略，但在ICL上使10个传感器网络配置中的8个明显退化，其中4个甚至劣于单变量推理。逐层分析显示，仅在第一个block将α均匀化即可改善所测试的全部ICL配置。

Conclusion: 组注意力的收益主要来自V/O的组内信息聚合，而非Q/K的跨变量权重学习；跨变量加权在ICL设定下往往有害，说明该机制对MV与ICL的适配性存在本质差异，第一个block的均匀化是改善ICL的简洁有效手段。

Abstract: Group attention, introduced by the time series forecasting model Chronos-2, attends over the variates of a group at a fixed patch index and serves both multivariate (MV) and in-context learning (ICL) forecasting. Rather than evaluating this cross-variate attention design as a whole, we ask which part of the mechanism earns the benefit and probe its applicability to both MV and ICL regimes. By editing the attention matrix $α$ at inference we separate the two pathways a head comprises: V/O, which projects a weighted summary of the group, and Q/K, which decides the weights. Uniform pooling (V/O without any Q/K weighting) is positive on 18 of our 20 sensor-network configurations, while the learned weighting (Q/K) splits by group type: its contribution is positive or negligible for MV, but materially degrades 8 of the 10 sensor-network ICL configurations, leaving 4 of them worse than univariate inference. By isolating the impact of different layers, we find that uniforming $α$ in the first block alone improves every ICL configuration we test.

</details>


### [238] [FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02198)
*Sebastian Sanokowski,Alireza Sarmadi,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FERPO：一种on-policy最大熵强化学习算法，利用critic值（不对动作求导）进行策略改进，通过前向KL目标拟合由熵与KL正则化的策略改进目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线连续控制强化学习中，主流方法依赖对critic求动作梯度来改进策略，但critic通常以预测回报为目标训练，准确的值预测并不保证准确的动作导数，可能导致不可靠的策略更新。

Method: FERPO从带熵与KL散度正则的策略改进目标中推导出最优目标动作分布；随后通过最小化前向KL目标将actor拟合到该目标，该目标用自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）估计，动作从rollout策略采样。限制目标分布相对rollout策略的偏差使重要性权重保持良好性质。

Result: 在MuJoCo Playground与ManiSkill上，实验与消融显示具有竞争力的性能与样本效率提升；计算基准表明actor更新速度快于REPPO。

Conclusion: 相比可能偏向目标分布部分模态的反向KL目标，前向KL目标鼓励覆盖多个高价值模态，从而促进探索；FERPO无需对critic求动作梯度即可完成策略改进，并带来效率优势。

Abstract: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).

</details>


### [239] [Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01889)
*Yohan Chatelain,Pablo de Oliveira Castro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究低精度Transformer推理中随机舍入(SR)与就近舍入(RN)的取舍，发现最优选择取决于舍入发生的位置：MLP下投影中SR更优，而语言模型头部RN更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度Transformer推理需要在SR与RN之间做出选择，但缺乏对"在何处使用何种舍入规则"的系统性理解，且缺少可在任意精度下进行实验的硬件支持工具。

Method: 1) 将PRISM向量化舍入库扩展为可变精度随机舍入(VPSR)算法，保持数值格式固定、仅改变单个操作位置的舍入规则，并证明舍入决策在硬件浮点下被精确评估；2) 提出两个理论分析：线性投影的概率前向误差界，以及输出softmax处交叉熵损失变化的二阶分解（符号漂移、漂移曲率、Fisher加权方差惩罚）。

Result: 在DistilGPT-2、t=6有效位下：MLP中使用SR使困惑度升至全精度参考的1.15倍，而RN为2.21倍；在语言模型头部顺序反转，SR因引入非均匀方差而劣于RN。混合精度配置(MLP输出t=6)下，MLP用SR、头部用RN可将困惑度控制在参考的1.10倍以内，相比同等比特的RN降低28%。

Conclusion: 舍入规则的优劣取决于操作位置：MLP噪声主要是softmax不变的均匀logit平移，SR的方差被大幅折价；头部噪声在词表上非均匀，故RN更优。按位置分配舍入规则可显著提升低精度推理质量。

Abstract: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point.
  We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not.
  On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.

</details>


### [240] [A foundation for systematic analysis of transformers and RNNs for tractography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01894)
*Emmanuelle Renauld,Philippe Poulin,Hugo Larochelle,Antoine Théberge,Maxime Descoteaux*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估RNN与Transformer在扩散MRI纤维追踪（tractography）中的迭代建模能力，提出生成-验证训练阶段，在ISMRM2015挑战数据集上取得迄今最佳性能，并量化训练集缺陷影响及体内数据适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dMRI纤维追踪本质上存在局部扩散信息与全局解剖合理性之间的张力：局部损失函数无法直接反映整条流线的全局质量。现有序列型深度学习方法在该任务上的训练策略、输入表示与超参数选择缺乏系统评估，其潜力和局限尚不明确。

Method: 系统性对比RNN与Transformer用于迭代式纤维追踪，重点考察训练策略、输入表示（CNN嵌入与EOS标记）及超参数选择；引入生成-验证阶段，在训练中对流线级别进行监督，以缓解局部损失与全局流线质量之间的不匹配；在ISMRM2015追踪挑战数据集上开展受控实验，改变缺失纤维束、含噪或不完美训练流线、无效纤维等因素，并迁移至Tractoinferno体内数据验证。

Result: 在ISMRM2015数据集上达到文献报道的最高性能；通过受控实验定量刻画了训练集中缺失纤维束、噪声/不完美流线及无效纤维对性能的影响；最佳模型可应用于Tractoinferno数据库的体内数据。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了Transformer与RNN等序列型深度学习模型用于纤维追踪的潜力与局限，强调需要更优的仿真模型（phantom）与评估方法来支撑体内验证，并为后续从事序列型监督追踪方法的研究者提供了经验与建议。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising approach for improving diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography, a task that remains limited by the intrinsic tension between local diffusion information and global anatomical plausibility. In this work, we systematically evaluate recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and Transformer models for iterative tractography, with particular attention to training strategies, input representations (including convolutional neural network (CNN)-based embeddings and end-of-sequence (EOS) tokens), and hyperparameter selection. We introduce a generation-validation phase enabling supervision at the streamline level during training, allowing supervision despite the mismatch between local loss functions and global streamline quality. Using the ISMRM2015 tractography challenge dataset, our models achieve the highest reported performance to date. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the impact of missing bundles, noisy or imperfect training streamlines, and invalid fibers in the training set. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of our best-performing models for in vivo data from the Tractoinferno database. Overall, our results highlight both the potential and the limits of sequence-based deep learning models such as Transformers and RNNs for tractography, and emphasize the need for improved phantoms and evaluation methods for in vivo validation. We provide takeaways and recommendations for future researchers training and validating sequence-based supervised methods for tractography.

</details>


### [241] [Higher-Order Positional Encodings for Graph Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01903)
*Caleb Stam,Aagrim Hoysal,Sanjukta Krishnagopal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出高阶位置编码（基于Hodge Laplacian），在不修改骨干模型的前提下将高阶拓扑信息注入图表示，理论证明其表达力优于标量图谱滤波器，实验验证预测性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图位置编码仅从原始图计算，无法直接捕获真实的群体高阶交互；拓扑深度学习虽通过提升到单纯复形解决此问题，但通常需在高阶神经网络表示上做消息传递或注意力，改变了骨干结构。作者希望找到一种既能利用高阶拓扑又无需修改骨干的表示学习范式。

Method: 将图提升为团复形（clique complexes），利用Hodge Laplacian导出高阶位置编码，使标准图学习模型能够利用提升后的关联结构而不修改骨干。并给出高阶位置编码表达力的理论刻画，证明高阶提升诱导的节点级算子能混合图拉普拉斯频率，方式超越标量图谱滤波器。

Result: 在ZINC及受控合成基准上，使用Graph Transformers取得预测性能提升；固定1-骨架实验表明，当单元独立于图提供时，该流水线能传递高阶信息。

Conclusion: 高阶位置编码可作为连接图位置编码与拓扑深度学习的桥梁，为在标准图学习模型中引入高阶拓扑信息提供了一条有效且有理论支撑的路径。

Abstract: Many real-world systems exhibit higher-order interactions among groups of entities that cannot be captured by pairwise relationships alone. Graph Transformers and Graph Neural Networks increasingly rely on positional encodings to enrich graph representations, yet existing positional encodings are computed solely from the original graph and therefore cannot directly capture observed higher-order interactions. Topological Deep Learning addresses this limitation by lifting graphs to simplicial complexes, but typically requires performing message passing or attention on higher-order neural network representations. We introduce a representation learning paradigm that enriches graph representations with higher-order topology through positional encodings, enabling standard graph learning models to exploit lifted incidence structure without modifying the backbone. We derive a theoretical characterization of the expressivity of higher-order positional encodings, proving that node-level operators induced by higher-order lifts can mix graph Laplacian frequencies in ways that scalar graph spectral filters cannot. Guided by this theory, we instantiate higher-order positional encodings using Hodge Laplacians derived from clique complexes. Experiments with Graph Transformers on ZINC and controlled synthetic benchmarks demonstrate improvements in predictive performance, while a fixed-1-skeleton experiment shows that the pipeline can transmit higher-order information when cells are supplied independently of the graph. Together, our results establish higher-order positional encodings as a principled bridge between graph positional encodings and topological deep learning.

</details>


### [242] [Same Reward, Different Skills: When Multimodal RL Learns to Look](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01908)
*Haocun Ye,Xinlong Jiang,Qile Chen,Bingyu Wang,Teng Zhang,Shubai Chen,Tingyu Wu,Zhenkun Zheng,Yiqiang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出RLVR中"提示中的图像不等于学习信号中的图像"，提出"视觉可解性"设计准则，并通过反事实坐标场景实验证明：只有视觉证据对正确答案必要时，RL才能真正学到视觉定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）能在训练时完全不使用视觉信息的情况下提升视觉语言基准分数，且盲训练模型在测试时加入图像后仍能恢复大部分增益，但长时真实图像训练反而侵蚀grounding能力而基准分数继续上升。这暴露出一个核心缺口：提示中的图像并不构成学习信号中的图像。作者希望明确什么条件下视觉证据才能真正被RL学习。

Method: 提出"视觉可解性"（visual resolvability）设计准则：要求视觉证据对正确答案是必要的，且任务保持可学习。在反事实坐标场景（counterfactual coordinate scenes）上测试，问题固定、目标从不被点名，正确答案必须依赖在图像中寻找目标。使用标准GRPO与正确性加格式奖励，在7B模型上训练。设置多组对照：测试图像替换为灰色画布、在灰色画布上训练（匹配步数30、四个随机种子）、以及在同一图像上加入能直接回答训练问题的caption。

Result: 7B模型在比训练集更密集的留出场景上，目标发现（discovery）准确率从0.425提升到0.875，并泛化到从未训练过的问题类型。将测试图像换为灰色画布时发现率降为零；在灰色画布上训练即使随后用真实图像测试也几乎无增益；学到的技能可迁移到独立于训练语料构建的grounding任务；加入可直接回答训练问题的caption后增益减少近三分之二。

Conclusion: 仅当视觉证据对正确答案必要且任务可学习时，RL才能真正学到视觉相关能力。改变奖励所要求的内容会改变RL所学习的内容，说明视觉可解性是设计RLVR任务的关键准则。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language benchmark scores even without visual information during training. With images at test, blind-trained models recover roughly half of the real-image gain at 3B and nearly four fifths at 7B. Prolonged real-image training can erode grounding while benchmark gains persist. Both findings expose the same gap: an image in the prompt is not an image in the learning signal. Our design rule, visual resolvability, asks that visual evidence be necessary for a correct answer and that the task remain learnable. We test it on counterfactual coordinate scenes in which the question stays fixed and the target is never named, so a correct answer requires finding the target in the image. With standard GRPO and correctness-and-format rewards, a 7B model raises its accuracy at finding the target (discovery) from 0.425 to 0.875 on held-out scenes denser than any it trained on, and it improves on question types it never trained on. Two controls locate the source of the gain. Replacing test images with gray canvases drops discovery to zero; training on gray canvases instead, at matched step 30 and in each of four seeds, yields essentially none of the gain even when the model is then tested with real images. The learned skill carries over to grounding tasks built independently of the training corpus. A caption that answers the training question, added to the same images, reward and budget, cuts the gain by nearly two thirds. Changing what reward requires changes what RL learns.

</details>


### [243] [Learning to Predict Distributions over Weight Updates for Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01934)
*Azal Ahmad Khan,Keshav Ramji,Tahira Naseem,Ali Anwar,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究仅利用输入查询（query）作为信号的超网络，用于 LoRA 参数估计，并提出分布化超网络以生成 LoRA 分布，实现"权重采样"式测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超网络多依赖任务描述或额外示例等信号来动态适配 LLM 参数，作者希望探究：仅凭输入查询本身能提供多少适配信号。同时，传统方法只给出参数适配器的点估计，缺乏不确定性建模与多样化的测试时扩展手段。

Method: 研究 query-conditioned 超网络用于 LoRA 估计；提出分布化超网络（distributional Hypernetworks），输出 LoRA 参数的概率分布而非单一点估计；采用可微蒙特卡洛近似的端到端损失，并探索回归与凸组合等多种分布参数化形式。

Result: 即使仅使用所学分布的均值，也能优于确定性超网络；该分布支持一种新的测试时扩展方式——采样权重更新得到多个适配模型，性能随采样数量增加而提升，且优于对应的 token 采样适配基线；生成的更新可跨查询迁移，表明超网络学到了可复用的适配结构。

Conclusion: 查询条件化的权重更新分布能够同时支撑模型适配与测试时扩展，仅依赖输入查询即可获得有效的适配信号，且分布建模带来性能与可扩展性优势。

Abstract: Hypernetworks have recently shown success in dynamically adapting the parameters of Large Language Models (LLMs) at runtime based on signals such as task descriptions or additional demostrations. Here we ask: how much adaptation signal can be obtained using only the input query to an LLM?. To answer this, we study query-conditioned Hypernetworks for LoRA estimation. Further, we introduce distributional Hypernetworks, able to produce not only point estimates of parameter adaptors, but also a distribution over possible LoRAs. For this we propose a simple end-to-end loss using a differentiable Monte Carlo approximation and explore multiple distribution parametrizations including regression and convex combination variants. Results show that even using the mean of the learned distribution can outperform deterministic hypernetworks. Crucially, the learned distribution enables a different form of test-time scaling: instead of spending additional compute only by sampling more token sequences from a fixed model, we sample weight updates, yielding multiple adapted models for the same query. Performance improves as more weight samples are considered and remains stronger than corresponding token-sampling adaptation baselines. Finally, we find that generated updates can transfer across queries, suggesting that the hypernetwork learns reusable structure in how the model should adapt. Together, these results show that query-conditioned distributions over weight updates can support both adaptation and test-time scaling.

</details>


### [244] [Graph Representation via Elements of Discrete Morse and Cobordism Theories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01937)
*Jennifer Rozenblit,Chenguang Yang,Yuxin Liu,Yuzhou Chen,Yulia Gel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张将低维拓扑（如Morse理论与cobordism理论）引入机器学习，提出MG-Diff流程，用离散Morse理论改进图扩散模型，并给出决策间隙下引导稳定的理论保证，应用于时空图预测与图再生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑天然适合刻画非线性、多尺度、非平稳结构，但在机器学习中其应用几乎局限于拓扑数据分析（TDA）。作者认为纯数学领域的低维拓扑工具（如Morse理论）为理解数据生成过程与学习任务的隐藏结构提供了互补且几乎未被探索的视角，因此希望拓展拓扑在机器学习中的作用范围。

Method: 引入cobordism（配边）理论的概念，并利用离散Morse理论工具，构建名为MG-Diff的流程，将其用于为图扩散模型提供诱导扩散引导（induced diffusion guidance），以提升模型性能；同时从理论上推导保证与充分条件。

Result: 推导出理论保证与充分条件，证明在存在正决策间隙（positive decision-gap）时，Morse理论工具及其用于诱导扩散引导的应用在小扰动下是稳定的；并在时空图预测与图再生任务上展示了离散Morse理论对图扩散模型的实用价值。

Conclusion: 离散Morse理论在图扩散模型上的成功应用只是低维拓扑能为机器学习领域所贡献内容的一小部分，作者呼吁进一步探索低维拓扑在机器学习中的潜力。

Abstract: Topology is, by its nature and design, suited to structure that is nonlinear, multiscale, and nonstationary - however, within machine learning, its use remains largely confined to topological data analysis. We advocate that tools from low-dimensional topology which have remained almost exclusively contained within the domain of pure mathematics (such as Morse theory) offer a strong, complementary, and yet virtually unexplored perspective on the hidden structure of data-generating processes and learning tasks built upon them. Here we introduce concepts from cobordism theory and harness tools from discrete Morse theory to improve the performance of graph diffusion models through our pipeline MG-Diff. Further, we derive theoretical guarantees and sufficient conditions so that under a positive decision-gap, the Morse-theoretic tools and their application for induced diffusion guidance are stable under small perturbations. Finally, we illustrate the utility of discrete Morse theory in application to graph diffusion models for spatio-temporal graph forecasting and graph regeneration, and argue that these applications are only a small window into the part of what low-dimensional topology can offer to the field of machine learning.

</details>


### [245] [Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01947)
*Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Xuemin Chen,Xiaozhuang Song,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent JEPA 框架，将自回归学习与对未来视图的联合嵌入预测相结合，在连续隐思维中训练化学推理直觉。在 ChemCoTBench 上，该方法在分子优化等任务上取得提升；表征分析显示未来预测使隐思维对分子结果更具信息量、并与化学结构对应更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学直觉能在解法细节尚未完全展开前提供对合理结果的初步判断，这种预期与显式分析互补。本文受此启发，希望连续隐思维能预判未来解法的关键信息，而无需将每个中间步骤都言语化，从而将连续隐推理与科学结果相连接。

Method: 提出 Latent JEPA 框架，把自回归学习与对一个或多个未来视图的联合嵌入预测（joint-embedding prediction）结合。针对化学推理设计了文本预测与分子预测两类目标，将隐思维同时关联到后续推理过程与分子结果。

Result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上，分子优化任务以及若干编辑与反应指标均获得提升。表征分析表明，未来预测使隐思维对分子结果更具信息量，并增强其与化学结构的对应关系。

Conclusion: 抽象的未来预测可作为一种学习原则，有效连接连续隐推理与科学结果，支持化学推理中的隐式直觉建模。

Abstract: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.

</details>


### [246] [Sharp Non-Asymptotic Analysis of the Penalized Challenger in $β$-EB-TCI for Bernoulli Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01951)
*Nam Nguyen,Tuan Quang Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Bernoulli赌博机中top-two算法（β-EB-TCI）在固定置信度最优臂识别下的非渐近行为，证明其停止时间达到下界T_β^*(μ)log(1/δ)（忽略低阶项），并给出尖锐期望样本复杂度结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: top-two算法虽简单有效，但其尖锐的非渐近行为尚不清楚，尤其是经验领先者何时永久正确、以及停止时间的精确刻画未被充分理解。

Method: 针对Bernoulli赌博机，分析Jourdan等人的经验最优top-two规则β-EB-TCI（挑战者由带对数计数惩罚的Bernoulli运输成本选出）。证明在经验领先者成为真实最优臂且其采样比例接近β后，停止时间约为T_β^*(μ)log(1/δ)；并证明该机制下每个挑战者被线性采样。若加入仅贡献O(√(Kt))次拉动的温和强制探索规则，得到自包含的期望样本复杂度定理。同时指出试图用单一索引比较处理相等次优均值的证明策略的局限。

Result: 证明了停止时间在低阶集中项意义下等于T_β^*(μ)log(1/δ)，且每个挑战者被线性采样。得到对所有具有唯一最优臂的Bernoulli实例的非渐近高概率界；在有限均值充分探索条件下进一步得到尖锐期望样本复杂度。特别地，在臂均值两两不同时，利用Jourdan等人的充分探索结果给出无保护Bernoulli规则的尖锐期望结果。加入温和强制探索后，得到唯一最优臂假设下任意臂数的自包含期望样本复杂度定理。

Conclusion: β-EB-TCI在唯一最优臂的Bernoulli实例下具有尖锐的非渐近和期望样本复杂度；主要剩余难点是控制经验领先者何时永久正确。所提强制探索方案可推广至任意臂数，并揭示了单一索引比较证明策略在处理相等次优均值时的局限性。

Abstract: Top-two algorithms are simple and effective for fixed-confidence best-arm identification, but their sharp non-asymptotic behavior is still not well understood. We study this problem for Bernoulli bandits through $β$-EB-TCI, the empirical-best top-two rule of Jourdan et al., whose challenger is chosen using a Bernoulli transportation cost with a logarithmic count penalty. We prove that, after the empirical leader has become the true best arm and its sampling fraction stays close to $β$, the stopping time is $T_β^{\star}(μ)\log(1/δ)$ up to lower-order concentration terms. We also show that, in this regime, every challenger is sampled linearly often. Thus, for the original algorithm without forced exploration, the main remaining difficulty is to control when the empirical leader becomes permanently correct. These results imply a non-asymptotic high-probability bound for all Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm. If the algorithm satisfies a finite-mean sufficient-exploration condition, the bound further yields the sharp expected sample complexity. In particular, this gives the sharp expectation result for the unguarded Bernoulli rule when all arm means are pairwise distinct, using the sufficient-exploration result of Jourdan et al. Finally, if we add a mild forced-exploration rule that contributes only $O(\sqrt{Kt})$ pulls up to time $t$, we obtain a self-contained expected sample-complexity theorem for any number of arms under the unique-best-arm assumption. We also identify a limitation of proof strategies that try to handle equal suboptimal means through a single index-comparison argument.

</details>


### [247] [Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01955)
*Yusuf Afifi,Artur Kiulian,Anton Polishko,Mykola Khandoga,Hamudi Naanaa,Alina Krasnobrizha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个基于2100+个已结算Polymarket问题构建的智能体预测环境、数据集与评测框架，让智能体在强化学习过程中自主获取证据信息，并用单轮GRPO以Brier分数为奖励训练Qwen3.5-35B-A3B模型，使其在基于证据的预测任务上超越包括Claude Opus 4.5在内的多个前沿模型，且推理成本仅约5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测研究要么在训练前冻结研究上下文，要么仅在测试时使用智能体式调研，导致"收集证据"这一能力从未被奖励信号塑造，模型的证据获取行为无法通过训练优化。

Method: 构建了由2100+个已结算Polymarket问题组成的智能体预测环境、数据集与评测框架；智能体在rollout阶段自主获取上下文（网络搜索、网页阅读、金融时间序列），并通过多层泄露过滤限制为问题截止时间前发布的信息；用单轮GRPO、以Brier分数为奖励训练Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（3B激活参数）。

Result: 训练改变了智能体与信息交互的方式：校准度提升30-40%，每次rollout的搜索尝试从3.8次降至2.25次，表明学会了证据纪律；在相同框架下与四个前沿模型对比，训练后的策略在基于证据的预测上领先所有被测前沿模型，包括Claude Opus 4.5（soft-Brier 0.254 vs 0.256，n=265），推理成本仅约5%，且在人群自身未形成定论的最难问题上优势最大。

Conclusion: 该工作将环境、数据集和逐rollout记录作为可复用的时间预测智能体评测框架开源发布，验证了将证据收集能力纳入强化学习奖励可以显著提升预测性能与证据纪律，并以低成本超越前沿模型。

Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can train language models to forecast real-world events, but prior forecasting work either freezes research context before training or deploys agentic research only at test time, so the skill of gathering evidence is never shaped by the reward. We introduce an agentic forecasting environment, dataset, and harness built from 2,100+ resolved Polymarket questions; the agent acquires its own context at rollout time (web search, page reading, and financial time series, all restricted by layered leak filtering to information published before each question's cutoff), and we train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (3B active parameters) on it with single-epoch GRPO under a Brier-score reward. Training changes how the agent interacts with information: calibration improves 30-40%, and search attempts fall from 3.8 to 2.25 per rollout as evidence discipline is learned. Evaluated in an identical harness against four frontier models, the trained policy also finishes ahead of every frontier model tested at evidence-based forecasting, including Claude Opus 4.5 (soft-Brier 0.254 vs. 0.256, n=265), at about 5% of the inference cost, and its margin is widest on the hardest questions, the ones the crowd itself had not decided. We release the environment, dataset, and per-rollout records as a reusable harness for temporal forecasting agents.

</details>


### [248] [SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01962)
*Si Qi Goh,Cap Dang Xuan Kiet,Tat-Jen Cham,Kwok-Yan Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SIEVE框架，通过对注意力值表示进行正则化并结合序列级遗忘/保留监督，实现视觉语言模型中对个人身份信息的选择性遗忘，在多个模型-模态设置下达到最先进性能且保留效用良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型能够将视觉身份与传记信息关联，因此需要在保留同一人物被允许知识的同时，选择性地遗忘其个人可识别信息（PII）。该任务的难点在于敏感信息与需保留信息往往共享相同的视觉输入和中间表示，难以区分。

Method: SIEVE直接对注意力值（attention-value）表示施加正则化，同时控制模型输出。具体而言，将遗忘样本的注意力值抑制到恒定零，并通过与冻结参考模型匹配来保留需保留样本的表示；结合序列级的遗忘与保留监督，实现定向遗忘。消融实验进一步分析值抑制、负交叉熵与基于参考的值匹配的作用。

Result: 在多种模型-模态设置下，SIEVE在遗忘任务上取得state-of-the-art性能，同时保持有竞争力的保留效用。消融显示：值抑制与负交叉熵提供互补的遗忘信号；基于参考的值匹配显著减少效用退化。

Conclusion: 当敏感知识与需保留知识高度相关时，注意力值是选择性多模态遗忘的一个有效干预点，SIEVE验证了该思路的有效性。

Abstract: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that SIEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on unlearning with multiple model-modality settings, while maintaining competitive retained utility. Ablation studies further show that value suppression and negative cross-entropy contribute complementary forgetting signals, while reference-based value matching substantially reduces utility degradation. These results demonstrate that attention values provide an effective intervention point for selective multimodal unlearning when sensitive and retained knowledge are closely related.

</details>


### [249] [Sim+Real: Joint Simulation - Experiment Training Improves Balanced Prediction in Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01974)
*Mahindra Rautela,Alexander Scheinker,Ayan Biswas,Diane Oyen,Nathan DeBardeleben,Earl Lawrence*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将仿真-实验预测建模为多目标学习问题，联合训练在平衡性能上优于Sim→Exp微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Sim→Exp微调仅优化实验目标，迁移后会损害仿真性能（仿真域遗忘），需要兼顾两个域的表现。

Method: 将仿真-实验预测表述为具有域特定仿真风险与实验风险的多目标学习问题；在RealPDEBench的四个流体系统和两种模型容量上，对比Simulation only、Experiment only、Sim→Exp、Joint四种训练方式，并在两个留存域上评估每个最终模型。

Result: Sim→Exp更强烈地专精于实验数据，代价是仿真域遗忘；Joint在广泛的仿真-实验评估权重范围内持续取得最佳平衡性能，同时显著提升对Sim→Exp的仿真保持能力，并更好地保留实验测量中缺失的仿真专属场。

Conclusion: 联合训练是缓解仿真域遗忘、兼顾两域性能的更优策略。

Abstract: Simulation and experimental measurements provide complementary data for learning spatiotemporal physical systems, but standard simulation-to-experiment fine-tuning optimizes only the experimental objective after transfer and can degrade simulation performance. We formulate simulation--experiment prediction as a multi-objective learning problem with domain-specific simulation and experimental risks. On four fluid systems from RealPDEBench and two model capacities, we compare Simulation only, Experiment only, Sim$\rightarrow$Exp, and Joint training, evaluating every final model on both held-out domains. Sim$\rightarrow$Exp tends to specialize more strongly to experimental data at the cost of simulation-domain forgetting. Joint training consistently achieves the best balanced performance over a broad range of simulation--experiment evaluation weightings, while substantially improving simulation retention over Sim$\rightarrow$Exp. Joint also better preserves simulation-only fields absent from experimental measurements. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph.

</details>


### [250] [The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01980)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Alice E. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究线性优化中决策聚焦学习因优化器不连续而难以处理的问题，证明在数据分布平均下非光滑的点态行为呈局部二次，并给出闭式曲率与可计算近似，弱收敛证明成立且应用于场景生成，在电池套利上取得30.8%的遗憾改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性优化的决策聚焦学习中，优化器具有不连续性：成本上的微小误差可能不改变决策，也可能使决策跳到另一个顶点。这种非光滑性阻碍了基于梯度的学习与风险分析，因此需要刻画其在分布层面的平滑结构并加以利用。

Method: 作者将分析从点态提升到分布层面，证明对数据分布平均后非光滑行为呈局部二次，并推导出闭式曲率——一个支撑于正规扇（normal fan）墙壁上的矩阵值测度；该测度仅依赖可行集，数据分布只作为权重进入。随后提出一个仅需一次向可行集投影即可计算的可处理近似，并证明该近似弱收敛到真实的总体曲率。最后将该理论用于期望成本线性优化的决策感知场景生成方法。

Result: 实验验证了二次性与弱收敛规律，并在电池套利任务上相比均匀分配取得30.8%的遗憾（regret）改进。

Conclusion: 分布平均可将线性优化决策映射的非光滑点态行为局部二次化，其曲率具有闭式且仅由可行集决定的矩阵值测度形式，并可用单次投影近似且弱收敛；该框架可支撑决策感知的场景生成，并在实证中显著降低遗憾。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.

</details>


### [251] [Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01981)
*Sibylle Marcotte,Joan Bruna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在深度而非宽度的"对偶"机制下研究自注意力模型的通用逼近能力，证明仅用两个冻结的单头残差 softmax 注意力块（高斯初始化投影矩阵），通过调整块的应用顺序、符号与持续时间，即可实现任意 N 个 n-token 序列集合间的插值，且结论对连续深度与有限深度均成立，并刻画了因果掩码带来的限制及其通用插值保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用逼近是学习架构能够受益于缩放律的必要定性性质，但既有验证多依赖无限宽度极限。作者转向与宽度对偶的"深度"机制，受 Looped Transformers 等参数跨层强共享模型启发，考察逼近能力是否可完全由深度提供，即是否存在预定义的有限参数集（跨层共享），仅靠块的应用顺序、符号与时长即可完成任意输入-输出序列集合间的映射。

Method: 采用深度主导、跨层强参数共享的设定：固定一组有限的注意力块参数（不随输入输出集合改变），仅让块的排列顺序、符号和持续时间依具体插值任务而变。主结果针对残差 softmax 注意力，使用仅两个冻结的单头块、投影矩阵按高斯初始化；分析在连续深度与有限深度两种情况下进行，并进一步分析因果掩码施加的约束并给出相应的通用插值保证。

Result: 证明仅需两个冻结的单头残差 softmax 注意力块（高斯初始化投影矩阵），即可将任意 N 个 n-token 序列集合映射为任意其他 N 个 n-token 序列集合，逼近能力完全由深度（块顺序、符号与持续时间）提供而非宽度；该结论在连续深度与有限深度下均成立。同时刻画了因果掩码所施加的限制，并建立了对应的通用插值保证。

Conclusion: 自注意力模型的通用插值能力可在"深度对偶"机制下实现，且所需参数极少（两个冻结单头块）并跨层共享，说明参数共享的深度架构具备强表达力；因果掩码会带来结构性限制，但仍可在相应条件下获得通用插值保证。这为 Looped Transformers 一类深度循环、参数共享架构的可扩展性提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Universal approximation is a necessary qualitative property of learning architectures to benefit from scaling laws. While it is generically verified on a variety of neural architectures and random feature models, it typically involves infinite width limits. In this work, we focus on deep self-attention models and consider instead the `dual' regime, where approximation power is enabled entirely by depth, and featuring strong parameter sharing across layers, motivated by recent models such as the Looped Transformers. More specifically, we ask whether one can find a predefined finite set of parameters, each defining an attention block, such that the resulting finite set of transformations can map any collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens to any other collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens. Crucially, these transformations are \emph{fixed independently of the input and output} collections: only the order in which the blocks are applied, their signs, and their durations depend on the particular interpolation task. Our main result establishes it for residual softmax attention using only two frozen single-head blocks with Gaussian-initialized projection matrices. The result holds at both continuous and finite depth. We also characterize the restrictions imposed by causal masking and establish corresponding universal interpolation guarantees.

</details>


### [252] [Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02012)
*Tristan Shah,Wooyoung Chung,Volodomyr Makarenko,Juan Wachs,Stas Tiomkin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Forward CIP (F-CIP)，一种无需变量选择的RL原生无监督目标，仅由系统动力学定义，可无监督发现平衡、保持可控性等原始行为，配上简单前向速度奖励即可学得跳跃、奔跑等协调步态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习依赖人类工程师为每个新任务设计奖励信号，成本高。无监督RL通过内在动机(IM)减少这种工程负担，但现有IM目标需要人为选择信息变量，重新引入了本应消除的领域专业知识，因此需要一种无需变量选择的IM目标。

Method: 作者提出F-CIP，将Controllable Information Production (CIP)目标重新表述为RL原生形式，该目标仅由系统动力学定义，不依赖任何信息变量选择；并证明F-CIP与RL兼容，可与现有算法结合使用。

Result: 用F-CIP训练智能体可无监督地发现平衡、维持可控性等原始行为（这些是更复杂机器人行为的基础）；将其与简单的前向速度奖励结合，能产生跳跃、奔跑等协调步态，而这些步态原本需要奖励工程才能习得。

Conclusion: F-CIP提供了一种无需变量选择、完全由动力学确定的无监督RL目标，兼容现有算法，能自发学到基础行为并降低对奖励工程的依赖，是无监督RL中一种有效且通用的内在动机方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful paradigm for training agents, yet its success rests on domain expertise of human engineers who design informative reward signals for every new task. Unsupervised RL aims to reduce this engineering with intrinsic motivation (IM): reward signals that emerge from the agent environment interaction itself. Existing IM objectives, however, involve the selection of information variables, which re-introduces domain expertise the field has sought to eliminate. We introduce Forward CIP (F-CIP), an RL-native formulation of the Controllable Information Production (CIP) objective, which is defined by the system's dynamics alone and requires no such selection. We prove that F-CIP is compatible with RL and demonstrate its effectiveness with existing algorithms. Training agents with F-CIP results in unsupervised discovery of primitive behaviors such as balancing and maintaining controllability, which are essential for more complex robot behaviors. Paired with a simple forward-velocity reward, our method produces coordinated gaits such as hopping and running which otherwise require reward engineering to learn.

</details>


### [253] [BranchIP: Learning Adaptive Equivariant Computation for Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02013)
*Laura Zichi,Gil Harari,Chuin Wei Tan,Marc L. Descoteaux,Albert Zhu,Menghang Wang,Yoel Zimmermann,H. T. Kung,Boris Kozinsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BranchIP：通过可学习自适应张量积计算与蒸馏损失，加速等变MLIP并省内存，同时保持物理精度与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等变机器学习原子间势（MLIP）虽革新原子模拟，但复杂材料与分子体系需昂贵模型，限制模拟尺度；张量积是主要计算瓶颈，基础规模MLIP进一步加剧该问题。

Method: 提出BranchIP——单模型框架，实现可学习的自适应张量积计算，并采用新颖的蒸馏损失进行训练。

Result: 在多相催化体系与质子传导固体酸电解质两个体系中，跨模型规模最高加速2.4倍，内存占用最多降低2.6倍，且保持物理保真度；自适应计算还揭示哪些相互作用需更深计算，及其与化学复杂性和动力学的关系。

Conclusion: BranchIP在保持物理精度的前提下显著提升MLIP效率，并提供可解释性，为大规模原子模拟提供可行路径。

Abstract: Equivariant machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have revolutionized atomistic modeling, but accurate treatment of complex materials and molecular systems demands expensive models. This limits simulation length- and time-scales, with tensor products a key computational bottleneck. The recent emergence of foundation-scale MLIPs further exacerbates this challenge. We present Branch Interatomic Potential (BranchIP), a single-model framework for learned adaptive tensor product computation, trained with a novel distillation loss. In our experiments on two systems of physical interest, a heterogeneous catalysis system and a proton-conducting solid acid electrolyte, BranchIP accelerates MLIPs across model sizes by up to $2.4\times$ while reducing memory usage by up to $2.6\times$. This is achieved while maintaining physical fidelity. Furthermore, the learned adaptive computation provides model interpretability by revealing which interactions demand deeper computation and showing how computational depth relates to chemical complexity and dynamics.

</details>


### [254] [Relative Transitions, Not Absolute Destinations: A Transfer-and-Ground Framework for Target-Trajectory-Free Human Mobility Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02033)
*Yidi Wang,Yunhe Zhang,Bangchao Deng,Dingqi Yang,Pengyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"无目标轨迹生成"问题：仅利用源城市轨迹与目标城市POI坐标和类别，提出Nomad框架，将"如何移动"与"在哪实现移动"解耦，通过相对语义位移先验与行为图落地，在10城14组迁移任务上优于适配基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹生成器依赖部署城市的观测数据，而恰恰在缺乏轨迹数据的城市无法适用；这些城市的POI及其属性却可从公开地图获取。同时，现有方法预测绝对目的地，把可复用的移动行为与城市特有的POI身份和空间布局纠缠在一起，限制了跨城市迁移。

Method: 提出Nomad，一个"迁移-落地"（transfer-and-ground）框架。核心是以上下文条件化的相对转移替代城市绑定的绝对输出：用历史条件化的流匹配（flow-matching）模型从源轨迹中学习一个转移先验，涵盖POI上下文间的语义位移、地理位移与经过时间；推理阶段通过行为图与"探索-返回"游走将采样到的转移落到目标POI地图上。该因式分解可在不假设整体移动分布不变的前提下，直接检验表示层面的可迁移性。

Result: 在10个城市、14组迁移上的大量实验显示，Nomad在轨迹保真度与下游效用上均优于适配基线；相对各指标最佳基线，分布保真度平均误差降低约15%，下游效用平均误差降低约3%。

Conclusion: 将移动行为的学习（相对语义转移先验）与移动的落地（目标城市POI图上的实现）分离，可有效实现无需目标城市轨迹的轨迹生成，验证了表示层面的可迁移性，并为缺乏轨迹数据的城市提供可行的轨迹生成方案。

Abstract: Individual mobility trajectories support urban analysis and location-based services, yet most trajectory generators require observations from their deployment city. This assumption excludes precisely the cities where trajectories are unavailable even though points of interest (POIs) and their attributes can be obtained from public maps. We study target-trajectory-free generation: learning from POIs and trajectories in source cities while utilizing only POI coordinates and categories in a target city, with no target trajectory or trajectory-derived statistic available for training, model selection, or generation. Existing trajectory generators typically predict absolute destinations, entangling reusable movement behavior with city-specific POI identities and spatial layouts. Our core insight is to replace this city-bound output with context-conditioned relative transitions. We propose Nomad, a transfer-and-ground framework that separates learning how people move from determining where those movements are realized. Specifically, a history-conditioned flow-matching model learns from source trajectories a transition prior over semantic displacement between POI contexts, geographic displacement, and elapsed time; at inference, a behavior graph and an exploration--return walk ground sampled transitions onto the target POI map. This factorization enables a direct test of representation level transferability without assuming invariance of the full mobility distribution. Extensive experiments across ten cities and 14 transfers show that Nomad outperforms adaptation baselines in trajectory fidelity and downstream utility, lowering the average error over the best baseline of each metric by about 15% in distributional fidelity and about 3% in downstream utility.

</details>


### [255] [Foundations without Fundamentals: Zero-Shot Blind Spots in Time Series FMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02058)
*Nafiseh Ghoroghchian,Haipeng Zhang,Shuyi Han,Alex Labach,George Stein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出诊断性基准 SimpleTimeBench，用于检验时序基础模型（TSFM）对基本时序逻辑（单调趋势、周期信号、领先指标协变量）的掌握能力；结果显示 Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto 等主流多变量 TSFM 在这些"应近乎完美预测"的简单场景下零样本表现不佳，微调亦无法带来可泛化的基础能力提升，且该缺陷在真实传感器预测中同样存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSFM 虽在广泛基准上表现优异，但其是否真正内化了基本时序逻辑（尤其在外生协变量支持下的场景）尚缺乏检验；作者希望区分"预训练规模带来的表面性能"与"可泛化的基础时序推理能力"。

Method: 构建 SimpleTimeBench——一个单变量与多变量的"单元测试"式诊断套件，覆盖单调趋势、周期信号、领先指标协变量等本应轻易预测的原语场景；对 Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto 等主流多变量 TSFM 进行零样本评测，并对 Chronos-2 做针对性微调以考察能力迁移，进一步在真实传感器预测任务中验证。

Result: 主流多变量 TSFM 在这些简单输入上频繁给出次优的零样本预测；微调 Chronos-2 虽能改善特定任务，却使其在其他基础模式上性能下降，而非提升可泛化的基础能力；缺陷并非仅存在于合成数据，在真实传感器预测中同样持续出现，模型普遍未能充分利用观测协变量中的领先指标。

Conclusion: 当前 TSFM 的预训练规模与基本时序推理能力之间存在明显鸿沟，模型可能缺乏捕捉简单可预测函数所需的归纳偏置；对简单关系建模的失败限制了现有多变量模型的实用性与可靠性。

Abstract: Despite the success of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) on broad benchmarks, their ability to internalize basic temporal logic, especially in settings supported by exogenous covariates, remains under-examined. We introduce SimpleTimeBench, a diagnostic univariate and multivariate "unit test" suite for primitives such as monotonic trends, periodic signals and leading indicator covariates, scenarios where near-perfect forecasts should be trivial. Surprisingly, prominent multivariate TSFMs (Chronos-2, Moirai and Toto) frequently produce suboptimal zero-shot forecasts for these inputs. While fine-tuning Chronos-2 improves its behaviour on specific tasks, we show that this adaptation degrades performance on other fundamental patterns rather than enhancing its generalizable foundational capabilities. This reveals a gap between pre-training scale and basic temporal reasoning, suggesting that current TSFMs could potentially lack the inductive biases needed to capture simple predictable functions. We further demonstrate that these failures are not merely synthetic curiosities: they persist in real-world sensor forecasting, where TSFMs consistently underutilize leading indicators available in observed covariates. This inability to capture simple relationships limits the practical utility and reliability of current multivariate models.

</details>


### [256] [Learn the Directions, Normalize the Gains: Post-Training Normalization for LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02067)
*Zailong Tian,Yanzhe Chen,Zhuoheng Han,Houfeng Wang,Lizi Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出LoRA-Norm方法，通过谱重平衡与核范数恢复，在不需校准数据和额外训练的情况下，缓解LoRA适配中的"适配不平衡"问题，提升任务专精与通用能力保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA虽能高效实现任务专精，但其学得的更新可能损害目标任务之外的能力。作者识别出"适配不平衡"现象：少数奇异方向主导了训练更新，使性能对增益分配方式高度敏感，因此"学习在哪里适配"并不能保证适配增益得到良好平衡。

Method: 提出LoRA-Norm，一种训练后归一化方法：在保留已学方向的前提下重新平衡其增益。该方法结合了谱重平衡（对奇异值施加固定非线性变换）与核范数恢复（保持原始总谱质量）。无需校准数据、无需额外训练，也不引入推理开销。

Result: 在两个骨干网络和三个适配任务上，LoRA-Norm提升了平均专精性能与能力保持，在两项指标上均优于所评估的训练后谱剪枝和梯度引导编辑配置。更强的函数均衡并未带来一致的额外增益，说明平衡适配器增益与均衡其响应是不同目标。

Conclusion: 适配增益的平衡与响应的均衡是相互区别的目标；LoRA-Norm通过谱层面的增益重平衡有效缓解适配不平衡，在提升任务专精的同时保持通用能力，且具备零额外开销的实用优势。

Abstract: While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient task specialization, its learned updates can compromise capabilities beyond the target task. We identify \textbf{adaptation imbalance}: a few singular directions dominate the trained update, leaving its performance sensitive to how gains are allocated. We argue that \textbf{learning where to adapt does not ensure that adaptation gains are well balanced}. This motivates \textbf{LoRA-Norm}, a post-training normalization method that retains learned directions while rebalancing their gains. LoRA-Norm combines spectral rebalancing, a fixed nonlinear transformation of singular values, with nuclear-norm restoration, which preserves the original total spectral mass. It requires no calibration data or additional training and introduces no inference overhead. Across two backbones and three adaptation tasks, LoRA-Norm improves average specialization and capability retention, outperforming the evaluated post-hoc spectral pruning and gradient-guided editing configurations on both measures. Stronger functional equalization brings no consistent additional gains, revealing that balancing adapter gains and equalizing their responses are distinct objectives.

</details>


### [257] [Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02098)
*Chuqin Geng,Li Zhang,Haolin Ye,Mark Zhang,Luke Zhang,Xujie Si*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出机制可解释性中"干预定义的忠实度"评价目标存在缺陷：它会偏好一个同等规模但行为复现更差的电路，形成"目标层面的恢复缺口"，且该问题在EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP等主流方法中普遍存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化电路发现通常被框定为搜索问题，默认"更好的归因或优化必然找到更好的机制"。但这一假设的前提是：评价目标在找到更优电路时能够正确识别它。作者质疑该前提，考察干预定义的忠实度指标本身是否可靠。

Method: 在四个人类参考任务及InterpBench上，将验证集忠实度与固定普通重采样下留出提示的行为表现进行对比。行为标准为与完整模型（含其错误）的一致性；在Greater-Than任务上改用语义准确率。通过受控的参考编辑，在不使用任何发现算法的情况下检验是否存在错误排序，并检验EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP的输出。进一步以"上下文失真"为解释，从接收方的完整模型执行中恢复被选信号，修复持续性的KL错误排序。

Result: 干预定义的忠实度会偏好同等规模但行为复现更差的电路。在人类参考任务上，重采样下KL在9.4%–41.2%的候选电路对中出现错误排序，四类发现方法的输出均表现出相同失败模式。受控参考编辑无需发现算法即可复现错误排序。恢复被选信号可修复发现池中100例持续性KL错误排序中的96例，且在验证集与留出提示上均有效，而电路及其原始行为分数保持不变。

Conclusion: 当评价目标奖励了错误的候选电路时，仅靠改进发现算法不足以解决问题；需要重新审视干预定义忠实度这类目标本身的有效性。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to recover the internal computations responsible for model behavior. Progress in automated circuit discovery is often framed as a search problem: better attribution or optimization should identify better mechanisms. This assumes that the evaluation objective can recognize a better circuit once it is found. We show that intervention-defined faithfulness can instead prefer an equally sized circuit that reproduces the model's behavior less well, creating an objective-level recovery gap. Across four human-reference tasks and InterpBench, we compare validation faithfulness with behavior on held-out prompts under fixed ordinary resampling. The behavioral criterion is agreement with the intact model, including its mistakes, except on Greater-Than, where we use semantic accuracy. Controlled reference edits reveal misranking without any discovery algorithm, and outputs of EAP, EAP-IG, ACDC, and Edge-SP exhibit the same failure. Under resampling, KL misranks 9.4%-41.2% of candidate pairs across these methods on the human-reference tasks. We investigate context distortion as an explanation: replacing excluded signals changes the inputs on which retained components operate. Restoring selected signals from the recipient's intact-model execution repairs 96 of 100 persistent KL misrankings from the discovery pool on both validation and held-out prompts. The circuits and their original behavioral scores remain unchanged. These findings show why better discovery alone is insufficient when its objective rewards the wrong candidate.

</details>


### [258] [Linear Programming Representations and Strongly Polynomial Algorithms for Robust Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02131)
*Han Zhong,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究具有理性多面体状态-动作矩形不确定性（奖励与转移）的鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP），构造了单个线性规划（LP）以恢复鲁棒最优值与所有最优平稳随机策略，并给出强多项式时间构造及复杂度分析，改进并建立了多类RMDP与回合制随机博弈的强多项式界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RMDP的标准求解通常依赖策略迭代等迭代方法，缺乏精确的LP刻画与强多项式复杂度保证；尤其在一般区间、加权ℓ1与Wasserstein不确定性下，已知复杂度界不足或不适用。

Method: 通过编码有限步鲁棒策略迭代过程，构造单个等价的LP，其最优解给出鲁棒最优值与最优平稳随机策略；在固定折扣因子下，该LP具有多项式维度与编码长度，并可在强多项式时间内构造。进一步提出鲁棒策略迭代的一般复杂度分析框架，将不确定性集上的最小化代价与策略评估的迭代次数结合。

Result: 在固定折扣因子下，改进ℓ1与ℓ∞ RMDP的已知复杂度界；为一般区间、加权ℓ1与Wasserstein RMDP以及具有这些不确定性集的回合制随机博弈建立新的强多项式界；LP在多项式维度与编码长度下可在强多项式时间内构造。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了RMDP的单一LP刻画与强多项式算法框架，统一并扩展了多类不确定性下的复杂度结果，并可推广到回合制随机博弈。

Abstract: We study linear programming (LP) representations and strongly polynomial algorithms for robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) with rational polyhedral state-action rectangular uncertainty in rewards and transitions. By encoding a finite sequence of robust policy-iteration steps, we construct a single LP whose optimal solutions recover the robust optimal value and all optimal stationary randomized policies. At fixed discount, the LP has polynomial dimension and encoding length and can be constructed in strongly polynomial time. We also develop a general complexity analysis of robust policy iteration that combines the cost of minimizing over uncertainty sets with the number of iterations needed to evaluate a policy. For a fixed discount factor, we use this analysis to improve the known complexity bounds for $\ell_1$ and $\ell_\infty$ RMDPs and establish new strongly polynomial bounds for general interval, weighted $\ell_1$, and Wasserstein RMDPs, as well as turn-based stochastic games with these uncertainty sets.

</details>


### [259] [Faynt: Scaling and Optimizing Policies for Competitive Melee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02144)
*Ali Janati,Nikita Kuzmin,Rohit Swamy,Charles Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Faynt系列Transformer策略（10M/75M参数），单检查点控制《任天堂明星大乱斗 近战》全部26个角色；经强化学习后在244场同角色对局中10M胜240场（98.4%），对零延迟Slippi-AI模型68场全胜；并开源权重、基准与自动化锦标赛平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏AI多为角色专用或存在动作延迟，缺乏通用、低延迟且可规模化的多角色策略；作者希望以单一策略覆盖全部26个角色，并通过架构、优化、缩放与超参迁移研究，将约84万人类回放的人类行为学习与后训练相结合，实现超越专家型对手的通用对局能力。

Method: 方法包括：两档规模的Transformer策略（10M、75M），单检查点控制26个角色；在约84万人类回放下进行行为克隆预训练（含架构、优化、缩放和超参迁移研究）；后训练由基于排名与结果的课程学习、75M到10M的知识蒸馏，以及仅限Fox镜像对局的强化学习组成。对照对象为14个保留21/24帧动作延迟的专家与多角色版本，以及私下提供的零延迟Slippi-AI模型。

Result: 10M在244场同角色对局中胜240场（98.4%），对所有发布版本均保持胜多负少，且未使用额外延迟；对零延迟Slippi-AI模型在两种条件设置下68场全胜。初始152场基准上，监督式10M胜率69.7%，优于预训练75M的45.4%，尽管前者留出集控制器预测损失更高。用于监督检查点选择的加权验证损失与四个策略的胜率排序一致。监督后训练后两模型每分钟受伤害更低、早期领先更大、先失一命后更常获胜。NVIDIA T4上记录状态下单次决策推理平均5.2 ms（10M）与8.7 ms（75M），不含模拟器执行与通信开销。

Conclusion: 单一多角色Transformer策略经人类回放预训练与课程、蒸馏、定向强化学习后训练后，可稳定超越带动作延迟的专家型对手并达到高胜率与低推理延迟；加权验证损失可有效替代胜率进行模型选择。作者开源权重、两套基准测试与自动化模型锦标赛平台，以支持可复现与后续研究。

Abstract: We introduce Faynt, a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee, each controlling all 26 characters with a single checkpoint. After reinforcement learning (RL), the 10M wins 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen specialist and multi-character releases on their supported rosters, with a winning record against every release. These opponents retain 21- or 24-frame action delays; Faynt uses no added delay, and we have not isolated the effect of this difference. In a separate evaluation against a privately supplied zero-delay Slippi-AI model, the 10M wins all 68 games across two conditioning settings. We study architecture, optimization, scaling, and hyperparameter transfer to guide pretraining on approximately 840,000 human replays. Post-training combines rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and RL restricted to Fox mirror matches. On the initial 152-game benchmark, the supervised 10M wins 69.7% of games, compared with 45.4% for the pretrained 75M, despite higher overall held-out controller-prediction loss. The weighted validation loss used for supervised checkpoint selection agrees with the win-rate ordering of all four pretrained and supervised policies. After supervised post-training, both models take less damage per minute, build larger early leads, and win more often after losing the first life. Optimized inference on recorded game states averages 5.2 ms per decision for the 10M and 8.7 ms for the 75M on an NVIDIA T4, excluding emulator execution and communication. We open-source the weights, both benchmark suites, and a platform for automated model tournaments.

</details>


### [260] [Muon meets Tamed Langevin: Momentum Preconditioning beyond Convex and gradient-Lipschitz Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02158)
*Nikolaos Makras,Sotirios Sabanis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究非凸、非全局梯度Lipschitz势能下矩阵空间Gibbs分布的采样问题，提出一族非二次动能构造的新型欠阻尼Langevin系统（动量预条件），并给出不变性、指数收敛与离散稳定性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典欠阻尼Langevin采样理论通常要求势能凸或梯度全局Lipschitz，而在矩阵空间等实际场景中这些假设往往不成立，导致采样算法的收敛性与稳定性缺乏理论保障。本文旨在放宽这些限制，为更一般的Gibbs分布提供可证明有效的采样动力学。

Method: 引入一族非二次动能函数，构建带动量预条件的欠阻尼Langevin系统：动能梯度充当动量的光滑谱"驯化"（spectral taming）项；在此松弛势能假设下证明目标Gibbs测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下建立指数收敛；进而分析对应Euler-Maruyama离散格式。

Result: 所提动力学在仅要求势能非凸且非全局梯度Lipschitz时仍保持目标Gibbs测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下实现指数收敛到平衡；Euler-Maruyama离散化获得时间一致（uniform in time）的矩界，且无需对势能梯度做任何修改。

Conclusion: 通过非二次动能与动量预条件设计，论文在更弱假设下实现了可行的Gibbs采样，并同时给出连续时间收敛性与离散时间稳定性保证，为矩阵空间等复杂分布的采样提供了理论工具。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions on matrix spaces whose potential energies are neither convex nor globally gradient-Lipschitz. We introduce a family of non-quadratic kinetic energies that lead to a new underdamped Langevin system with momentum preconditioning, in which the gradient of the kinetic energy acts as a smooth spectral taming of the momentum. We prove that, under these relaxed assumptions on the potential, the resulting dynamics leaves the target Gibbs measure invariant, and we establish exponential convergence to equilibrium in a weighted total variation distance. Finally, we show that the corresponding Euler-Maruyama discretization admits moment bounds that are uniform in time, without any modification of the potential gradient, which ensures the stability of the resulting sampling algorithm.

</details>


### [261] [When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02159)
*Scott W. Viteri,Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez,Clark Barrett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出以"反事实信息"获取为准则的形式化探索标准，比较不同策略历史对替代策略经验的替代能力，并构造单一环境证明既有内在奖励（计数、预测误差、赋权、信息增益）的最优策略在该准则下均为Pareto次优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一系列内在奖励（如预测误差、学习进步）被用于引导强化学习中的探索，但最大化这些奖励并不必然产生最具信息量的经验。作者希望建立一个更本质的探索评价准则，并揭示既有奖励的失效根源与适用条件。

Method: 构造一个单一、简单的环境，将计数式奖励、预测误差、empowerment（赋权）与信息增益等指定目标嵌入其中，比较其最大化策略与"反事实信息"准则下的最优策略；分析这些目标失效的原因，推导既有内在奖励能有效促进最优探索的条件；并提出一个在探索按该准则严格改进时赋予更高价值的新目标函数。

Result: 在该环境中，计数式、预测误差、empowerment 与信息增益目标的最大化策略在获取反事实信息方面均Pareto次优；作者给出了这些失败的机理，并明确了既有内在奖励能成功鼓励最优探索的条件；同时构造出与反事实信息准则一致的新目标。

Conclusion: 内在奖励的最优性依赖具体环境与准则，最大化内在奖励不等于最具信息量的探索；以反事实信息为准则可统一刻画探索的最优性，并为设计与该准则对齐的新目标提供基础。

Abstract: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, simple environment in which specified count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, and information-gain objectives have maximizing policies that are Pareto-suboptimal at acquiring counterfactual information. We explain these failures and establish conditions under which existing intrinsic rewards successfully encourage optimal exploration. We also construct an objective that assigns a higher value whenever exploration strictly improves under our criterion.

</details>


### [262] [Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02173)
*Areeb Ahmad,Pratinav Seth,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出自修复现象的单一解释：消融前的增益差异，并证明细粒度单元的因果修复响应遵循仿射定律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前最系统的研究认为语言模型的自修复是噪声性的、难以用单一机制解释；本文旨在反驳这一结论，为自修复提供一个统一的机理解释。

Method: 将任何因果重要组件上的干预视为反事实对比强度坐标轴 λ 上的点，指出传统消融只是未校准的点；提出并验证细粒度单元 r 的因果修复响应遵循仿射定律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，其中斜率 γ_r 为固定系数，其符号决定该单元是抵消还是强化被移除信号。在事实判定任务上测试 Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral 四个模型，覆盖 MLP 神经元、OV 神经元和奇异方向；并在 GPT-2 Small 的 IOI 电路上验证。

Result: 在事实判定任务中，81 个下游方向里有 68 个遵循该仿射定律，且 γ_r 的幅度可由固定权重预测；在 GPT-2 Small 的 IOI 电路上，干预可触及的 10 个头中有 7 个遵循该定律，且全部为反向权重。

Conclusion: 看似自修复的现象，本质上是反向权重在核心处出现对比信号时执行其常规操作；自修复并非噪声性的，而可由仿射定律统一解释。

Abstract: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.

</details>


### [263] [Effective Resistance and Graph Neural Network Reliability in Tissue-Specific Interactomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02175)
*Jianru Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验组织特异性互作网络中的有效电阻（effective resistance）是否能指示蛋白质功能注释中"哪些预测不可信"。结果显示该信号在24个组织互作组中受逆度数支配（Spearman=-0.955），其残余偏离在控制多个混杂因素后仍能在19/24网络中额外解释节点级损失，且效应随深度单调增强，但选择性预测提升甚微。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质功能注释不仅需要模型预测结果，更需要知道哪些预测不可信。作者希望探究组织特异性互作结构是否携带这种"可信度"信息，从而为预测的可靠性评估提供结构层面的依据。

Method: 以有效电阻作为候选信号（此前用于通过重连缓解过挤压问题）。在24个组织特异性互作组上分析有效电阻的分布，与逆度数比较并计算Spearman相关；通过与度数保持的零模型图对比考察残余偏离；在控制预测熵、度数、注释基数、局部结构和纯特征难度后，用置换检验扣除"地板值"，考察残余能否解释节点级预测损失，并逐层分析其随深度的变化，同时与度数保持的零世界重训练模型对比。

Result: 有效电阻在24个网络中均被逆度数支配，且随共表达过滤网络增大而退化加剧（Spearman=-0.955）；残余偏离在所有24个网络中超过度数保持零模型。控制多种因素并扣除置换地板后，残余在19/24的留出网络中额外解释节点损失，且在每一深度均成立并随深度单调增强。增量达到控制变量未解释方差的0.37%，为置换地板的5.6倍，而在度数保持的零世界重训练模型下仅为1.5倍。选择性预测几乎无提升。

Conclusion: 该信号具有可重复性，但受度数退化限制其作用边界。有效电阻能在一定范围内提供关于"哪些预测不可信"的额外信息，然而对实际选择性预测的改善可以忽略，说明其应用价值受结构退化的约束。

Abstract: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. The increment reaches 0.37% of the variance the controls leave unexplained, 5.6 times a permutation floor, against 1.5 times when the model is retrained in a degree-preserving null world. Selective prediction improves negligibly. The signal is reproducible; degree degeneration bounds it.

</details>


### [264] [From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02179)
*Siqi Zhu,Suozhi Huang,Kaixuan Zhang,Yuheng Yang,Zhanyang Jin,Yihang Sun,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探讨多教师在线策略蒸馏中教师信号如何影响参数变化，发现损失平均方式、Adam一阶矩、BF16舍入及梯度近似方式均显著影响教师信号与学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏旨在将多个RL训练教师的能力整合到单一学生模型中，但教师信号如何影响参数变化尚缺乏深入理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 以Qwen3-1.7B为学生，使用四个由同一初始化经RL训练的领域教师，比较梯度、优化器更新和任务学习曲线，并辅以SmolLM3-3B诊断；分析损失平均、Adam一阶矩、BF16舍入及top-64交集KL梯度的影响。

Result: 损失平均隐含加权响应：token平均偏好长响应，等化领域贡献仍保留域内加权；Adam一阶矩降低参数更新差异（教师间余弦相似度0.83，平均规则间0.96）；BF16舍入掩盖小变化（FP32主权重约97%偏离初始化，BF16仅7–11%）；top-64交集KL梯度接近全词表梯度，但任务效果取决于平均方式：响应平均下数学准确率比采样token PG高2.6分，全局token平均下低2.1分。

Conclusion: 教师信号受多重因素影响：损失平均方式、优化器动量、数值精度及梯度近似均会改变参数更新与任务表现，多教师蒸馏设计需综合考虑这些因素。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aims to combine the strengths of RL-trained teachers in a single student, but how teacher signals affect parameter changes remains underexplored. We study Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the same initialization as the student, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics. We find that several factors influence teacher signals. First, loss averaging implicitly weights responses: token averaging favors longer responses, and equalizing domain contributions retains this weighting within domains. Second, Adam's first moment reduces differences in parameter updates: the cosine similarity is 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules, despite differences in raw gradients. Third, BF16 rounding hides small changes: about 97\% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization, but only 7--11\% of BF16 weights do. Finally, the top-64 intersection KL gradient closely matches Qwen's full-vocabulary gradient, but the effect on task performance depends on averaging: mathematics accuracy is 2.6 points higher than with sampled-token policy-gradient (PG) under response averaging and 2.1 points lower under global token averaging.

</details>


### [265] [Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02185)
*Weihao Liu,Huangjie Zheng,Tianrong Chen,Rohit Dilip,Richard He Bai,Yizhu Jiao,Yuyang Wang,Ruixiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoopCD 提出一种免训练对比解码框架，利用循环 Transformer 早期与最终循环状态的弱-强预测对，在 logit 或隐状态空间进行对比引导，在提升解码质量的同时将循环深度减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复执行共享块实现参数效率，每次循环都产生可解码同一 next token 的中间表示，但标准解码会丢弃较早状态。由于早期循环蕴含更少的计算量，循环本身天然提供了对齐的弱-强预测对，无需辅助模型或额外训练即可加以利用。

Method: 提出 LoopCD 训练-free 对比解码框架，用最终预测与较早循环轮次进行对比来引导 token 选择。提供两种变体：LoopCD-Logits 在 logit 空间操作，需额外一次输出前向；LoopCD-Hidden 在隐状态空间操作，无额外输出开销。

Result: 在四个循环 Transformer 家族上全循环深度均取得显著且一致的提升：LoopCD-Logits 将 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 的 AIME 2024 pass@1 从 61.88% 提升到 73.33%；LoopCD-Hidden 将 Huginn 的 HumanEval pass@1 从 22.56% 提升到 31.71%。性能增益还可将循环次数减半，仍匹配或超过全深度未引导基线，前向 FLOPs 降低 22.5%–48.2%。

Conclusion: LoopCD 将中间循环状态转化为有效的引导信号，实现了更优的解码质量，同时大幅降低推理计算量。

Abstract: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.

</details>


### [266] [Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02189)
*Jason X. Liu,Sebastian Ibarraran,Frank Hu,Soojung Yang,Xinyu A. Feng,Abigail Park,Anagha Aneesh,Lacramioara Bintu,Alexander R. Dunn,Grant M. Rotskoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IDiom（基于54M预测IDR数据集训练的自回归蛋白语言模型）及RL-SAE后训练方法，实现可控、可解释、可组合的IDR设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IDR在转录调控、信号转导、亚细胞定位等过程中发挥核心作用，但其功能设计困难：基于结构的设计方法不适用于IDR；现有蛋白语言模型在全长序列上训练，先验偏向折叠结构域。

Method: 构建IDiom-DB（从AlphaFold Database筛选的5400万条预测IDR）；训练自回归蛋白语言模型IDiom；提出RL-SAE后训练方法，以稀疏自编码器特征为奖励，激励生成激活指定特征集的序列。

Result: IDiom可生成在组成、模式、基序和预测无序性上复现天然IDR的多样序列；在8项IDR设计任务中，RL-SAE平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，而激活引导仅为24%；相比引导和监督微调，RL-SAE改善了生成IDR的预测亚细胞定位与转录活性，并可将不同生物功能相关特征组合进单条序列。

Conclusion: IDiom与RL-SAE通过显式控制功能相关序列特征，实现可解释、可组合的IDR设计；RL-SAE有望推广至其他可提供可解释特征作为设计目标的蛋白设计场景。代码已开源。

Abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

</details>


### [267] [Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02190)
*Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZFO框架，将优化方向选择与步长解耦：用可信的一阶优化器确定方向，仅沿该一维子空间做零阶评估，以低于完整线搜索的代价实现曲率感知的自适应步长选择，并在语言模型上验证了其相对固定步长基线的优化与最终性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模神经网络优化中步长选择是核心难题：步长保守会导致收敛缓慢，步长激进则可能造成训练不稳定。既有的线搜索方法代价较高，因此需要在保证可靠性的前提下降低步长选择开销。

Method: 结合零阶与一阶优化（ZFO），构建轻量级框架，将方向选择与步长选择解耦。由可信的一阶优化器确定更新方向，仅沿该一维子空间进行零阶函数评估；利用当前梯度信息外加两次额外目标函数评估，沿该方向构造目标函数的局部模型，并在有界搜索区间内选取曲率感知步长，形成开销小于完整线搜索的自适应步长机制。

Result: 理论层面证明了三点：共享样本评估可产生可靠的有限差分曲率估计；诱导的局部模型可在搜索区间内选出近似最优步长；ZFO可收敛至驻点邻域。

Conclusion: 在所评估的多种设置、语言模型与数据集上，ZFO相较于固定步长的一阶基线常能改善优化过程与最终性能，改进幅度及偏好的局部模型类型依赖于具体目标。代码已公开。
