### [433] [Localizing Post-Wire Semantic Changes in MCP Agent Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00182)
*Aditi Patodiya*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对 MCP 集成的差分测试方法，沿固定工具结果在各框架公共接口上的路径检查消费端显式需求，在 4 个固定版本的 Python 集成、18 个设计夹具中发现 13 个唯一的分歧，涉及结构化值、声明错误与富内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合法（wire 层有效）的 MCP 消息并不保证 agent 框架在下游保留软件所需的语义区分；现有工作缺乏对"消息合规"与"消费端保真"之间差距的接口级证据。

Method: 差分测试方法：让同一固定工具结果依次通过各框架的公共接口，并按显式消费端需求进行判定；在 4 个固定版本 Python 集成上使用 18 个设计夹具；辅以对缺失可选字段与 null 等价性的处理假设分析、对 JSON 文本再解析的探索性重放，以及在冲突输出压力用例与故障用例上检验 oracle 弱点并修复。

Result: 识别出 13 个唯一的夹具-任务分歧（结构化值、声明错误、富内容）；Google ADK 在所观测路径上满足全部主要契约，其余集成出现接口特定的改变或执行失败。将缺失可选字段视为等价于 null，可解释 OpenAI 大部分严格的富内容失败。探索性重放中，解析 JSON 文本可恢复更多结构化值，但同时产生错误取值以及源端不存在字段的取值。文档化设置有助于冲突输出压力场景，但未恢复独立的结构化槽位。

Conclusion: 该研究提供来自受控用例的可复现、接口特定证据，而非生产故障率或模型行为度量。其实践含义是：wire 之后的回归测试必须同时规定所需信息与消费端的读取方式。

Abstract: Valid Model Context Protocol (MCP) messages do not guarantee that an agent framework preserves the distinctions downstream software needs. We present a differential testing method that follows a fixed tool result through each framework's public interfaces and checks explicit consumer requirements. Applied to 18 designed fixtures in four pinned Python integrations, the method identifies 13 unique fixture-task divergences involving structured values, declared errors, and rich content. Google ADK satisfies every primary contract in its observed path; the other integrations show interface-specific changes or an execution failure. Whether a change matters depends on the consumer: treating absent optional fields as equivalent to null explains most of OpenAI's strict rich-content failures. In an exploratory replay, parsing JSON text recovers more structured values but also returns incorrect values and values for fields absent at the source. Documented settings help in conflicting-output stress cases without restoring a separate structured slot. Fault challenges expose an oracle weakness and test its repair on fresh cases. The study provides reproducible, interface-specific evidence from controlled cases, not production failure rates or model-behavior measurements. Its practical implication is that post-wire regression tests need to specify both the information required and how the consumer reads it.

</details>


### [434] [Testing and Verification of Quantum Compilers through Assurance Contracts and Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00255)
*Furqan Nasir,Muhammad Arif Shah,Iftikhar Alam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇整合性综述，比较量子编译器保障中的验证变换、等价性检查、差分与蜕变测试、基于属性的测试及跨版本证据，并提出适用性指导与待评估的回归架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子编译器保障需要与预期用途匹配的语义关系，以及能在交付接口暴露违规的观测手段；现有各类保障方法分散，缺乏统一比较与适用性界定。

Method: 通过来源目录与聚焦提取矩阵，区分形式化保证、经验发现、分析性推论与实践建议；采用可审计的覆盖更新与来源级筛选决策；结合四个失败案例（条件适用性、参数关联、终止性、相位约定）及一个涉及布局元数据、参数绑定与辅助量子比特的实例；并构造修订场景以区分故障检测与变更归因。

Result: 给出适用性、互补观测及不确定结果处理指南；表明已发表的缺陷计数、变异结果与处理基准支持不同主张，无法建立统一的效能排序。重建解释下验证电路可能遗漏交付接口检查；修订场景可分离故障检测与变更归因。

Conclusion: 所提回归架构作为完整系统尚未评估，其实际价值需在独立裁决的编译器变更事件上进行受控比较。

Abstract: Quantum compiler assurance requires a semantic relation that matches the intended use and observations that can expose violations at the delivered interface. This critical integrative survey compares verified transformations, equivalence checking, differential and metamorphic testing, property-based testing, and evidence for assurance across revisions. A source catalogue and focused extraction matrix distinguish formal guarantees, reported empirical findings, analytical deductions, and proposed practice. A recorded coverage update and source-level selection decisions make the review auditable within its declared scope. Four documented failure cases connect conditional applicability, parameter association, termination, and phase conventions to method selection. A worked example involving layout metadata, parameter bindings, and ancillary qubits demonstrates why validating a circuit under a reconstructed interpretation can leave the delivered interface unchecked. An illustrative revision scenario then separates fault detection from change attribution. The resulting guidance specifies applicability, complementary observations, and treatment of inconclusive outcomes. Published bug counts, mutation results, and processing benchmarks support different claims and do not establish a common effectiveness ranking. The proposed regression architecture remains unevaluated as a complete system; its practical value requires controlled comparisons on independently adjudicated compiler-change events.

</details>


### [435] [Code That Works, Environments That Don't: Measuring Environment Reproducibility in AI-Generated Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00425)
*Bhanu Prakash Vangala,Tanu Malik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出智能体协议与"声明-运行时安装-必要充分依赖"三层框架，系统评估编码智能体在环境依赖规范上的表现，发现其存在系统性泛化失败：依赖规范不一致、冗余或不完整，且功能测试无法检测，最新智能体亦无显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码生成已成为大语言模型的核心能力，但功能正确性无法覆盖生成质量的关键维度——环境规范（准确识别执行生成代码所需的依赖）。现有基准未捕获该维度，导致编码智能体在依赖规范上的系统性失败被忽视。

Method: 提出环境规范的智能体协议，并构建三层框架（声明依赖、运行时安装依赖、必要且充分依赖），据此在3个智能体、4种编程语言、50个编程任务上评估依赖错误规范的普遍程度及其跨因素变化。

Result: 当前编码智能体在该维度上表现系统性泛化失败，产生不一致、冗余或不完整的依赖规范，且功能测试无法检测；相同任务下不同智能体的依赖集合一致率低至7%；更新版本智能体无实质性提升；最大分歧出现在声明层与运行时依赖层之间，指向模型训练分布中学到的环境先验是主要驱动因素。

Conclusion: 环境规范是代码生成质量中一个独立且可度量的维度，现有基准未予捕获；应推动同时优化功能正确性与环境可移植性的训练目标与评估协议。

Abstract: Code generation has emerged as a central capability of large language models, with coding agents now able to produce functionally correct software projects from natural language prompts. However, functional correctness alone does not capture a critical dimension of generation quality: environment specification, defined as the accurate identification of the dependencies required to execute generated code, is equally critical. We develop an agent protocol for environment specification and introduce a three-layer framework comprising declared, runtime-installed, and necessary-and-sufficient dependencies to systematically assess coding agents for environment specification. Using this protocol, we evaluate the extent to which coding agents systematically misspecify software environment dependencies and how this misspecification varies across three agents, four languages, and fifty programming tasks. Our results show that current coding agents exhibit systematic generalization failures along this dimension, producing dependency specifications that are inconsistent, redundant, or incomplete in ways that functional tests do not detect. Across agents, dependency set agreement is as low as 7% for identical tasks, and newer agents show no meaningful improvement, suggesting the failure is not resolved by scale or recency. The largest divergence occurs between the declared and runtime dependency layers, implicating environment priors learned from the models' training distributions as the primary driver. Our findings establish environment specification as a distinct, measurable axis of code generation quality that current benchmarks do not capture, and motivate training objectives and evaluation protocols that jointly optimize for functional correctness and environmental portability.

</details>


### [436] [Extending LLM-based support for software engineers with ADHD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00555)
*Aarsh Shah,Ronnie de Souza Santos,Italo Santos,Cleyton Magalhaes,Kiev Gama*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出面向ADHD软件工程师的LLM助手Tether 2.0，通过工作流导向交互支持规划、编码、调试与评审，专家反馈和实际使用表明其有助于任务推进与中断后恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件工程工作流通常未考虑ADHD开发者在任务启动、持续注意和任务完成方面的困难；现有LLM编程工具也未考虑神经多样性，缺乏对跨开发任务结构化推进的支持。

Method: 基于原Tether系统开源代码构建Tether 2.0，结合结构化交互模式、活动感知上下文和持久记忆，覆盖规划、编码、调试、评审等工作流环节，并通过专家反馈与一位ADHD软件工程师的实际使用进行评估。

Result: Tether 2.0支持需求澄清、任务分解、增量实现、调试和任务完成，并能帮助用户保持进度、在中断后恢复工作。

Conclusion: 当LLM助手以工作流结构和上下文感知交互为设计核心时，可支持软件开发中的方向引导、持续进展与学习，为神经多样性开发者提供有效辅助。

Abstract: Software engineering workflows are often not designed to accommodate the needs of developers with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), despite known challenges related to task initiation, sustained attention, and completion. At the same time, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into programming tools, but existing systems do not account for neurodiversity or support structured progression across development tasks. In this work, we present Tether 2.0, an LLM based assistant designed to support software engineers with ADHD through workflow oriented interaction across planning, coding, debugging, and review. The tool was named Tether 2.0 because it builds upon the open source code and foundations of the original Tether system. Our approach combines structured interaction modes, activity aware context, and persistent memory to support task progression and continuity. We evaluate the system through expert feedback and hands on use with a software engineer with ADHD. Our results indicate that Tether 2.0 supports requirement clarification, task decomposition, incremental implementation, debugging, and completion, while enabling users to maintain progress and resume work after interruptions. These findings suggest that LLM based assistants can support direction, sustained progress, and learning in software development when designed with workflow structure and context aware interaction.

</details>


### [437] [Understanding and Mitigating Library-Related Issues in LLM-Generated Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00622)
*Yacine Majdoub,Rinad Hamid,Eya Ben Charrada,Ahmad Abdellatif,Haifa Touati*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种代理式（agentic）方法，通过任务分析、文档接地、代码生成与自动验证四阶段流程，缓解LLM生成代码中的库相关错误；在LangChain、AutoGen等快速演进的Python框架上的300个任务、5个LLM评估中，库相关错误减少38.1%–54.6%，代码正确率最高提升16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件开发者越来越多依赖LLM生成集成外部库的代码，但LLM常产生库使用错误（无效导入、过时API调用、幻觉依赖），导致编译或运行时失败，降低AI辅助开发的可靠性，因此需要系统性刻画并缓解此类问题。

Method: 首先开展探索性研究，分析100个LLM生成代码文件以刻画库相关问题的模式；据此设计代理式方法，将任务分析、文档接地（documentation grounding）、代码生成与自动化验证整合到代码合成流程中。在由快速演进Python框架（LangChain、AutoGen）真实实现衍生的300个代码生成任务上，跨GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3、Mistral、Llama 3五个模型进行评估。

Result: 探索性研究发现84%的生成文件至少含一个库相关错误，典型模式包括错误导入路径、缺失导入、幻觉库、过时库用法和未使用导入。评估结果显示，该方法在所有模型上一致提升生成质量：库相关错误减少38.1%–54.6%，代码正确率最高提升16%。

Conclusion: 库相关错误在LLM生成代码中高度普遍，所提出的代理式方法能跨多种LLM稳定降低此类错误并提升代码正确性，为提升AI辅助软件开发的可靠性提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Software practitioners increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate code that integrates external libraries. However, LLMs often produce incorrect library usage, such as invalid imports, outdated API calls, and hallucinated dependencies, leading to compilation or runtime failures that reduce the reliability of AI-assisted software development. In this paper, we propose an agentic approach to mitigate libraryrelated errors in LLM-generated code. More specifically, we first conduct an exploratory study to characterize the library-related issues produced by LLMs. Our analysis of 100 LLM-generated code files reveals that 84% of generated files contain at least one library-related error, with recurring patterns including incorrect import paths, missing imports, hallucinated libraries, deprecated library usage, and unused imports. Based on these findings, we design an agentic approach that integrates task analysis, documentation grounding, code generation, and automated validation to improve library usage during code synthesis. We evaluate our approach on 300 code generation tasks derived from realworld implementations of rapidly evolving Python frameworks, including LangChain and AutoGen, across five LLMs: GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3, Mistral, and Llama 3. The results show that our approach consistently improves code generation quality across all evaluated models, reducing library-related errors by 38.1% - 54.6% and increasing code correctness by up to 16%.

</details>


### [438] [ASAD: Adaptive Software Agents for Debugging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00629)
*Yacine Majdoub,Eya Ben Charrada,Haifa Touati*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出ASAD，一种自适应多智能体调试系统。它根据缺陷的性质与复杂度动态配置智能体团队（数量、角色、协作策略），由中心协调者通过迭代规划、反思与执行来编排流程。在Defects4J、DebugBench和CodeFlaws上，ASAD较CoT提示提升修复率12–20%，较静态多智能体系统修复精度提升4–9%，同时智能体使用量平均减少32%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体调试框架依赖僵化的预定义架构：智能体数量、角色与交互模式在分析缺陷前就已固定。这种"一刀切"方式与软件缺陷的异质性不匹配——简单缺陷浪费资源于不必要的协调，复杂缺陷则因专长不足或错配而表现不佳。因此需要一种能按缺陷特性自适应配置团队的调试系统。

Method: ASAD首先分析缺陷代码，动态确定需部署的智能体数量、应具备的专门化角色以及应遵循的协作策略。中心协调者通过迭代式规划、反思与执行来编排该过程：对简单问题采用快速单遍修复，对更复杂的失败则组建专门定制的团队。系统在Defects4J、DebugBench、CodeFlaws三个基准上，使用DeepSeek-V3、Qwen-3、GPT-5等多种LLM进行评估。

Result: ASAD在修复率上较思维链（CoT）提示稳定提升12–20%；较静态多智能体系统在修复精度上稳定领先4–9%，同时平均智能体使用量减少32%。系统能动态调整智能体数量与角色：以最少协调解决简单缺陷，仅对复杂情形扩展智能体参与度。

Conclusion: ASAD通过按缺陷复杂度自适应配置智能体团队，克服了静态多智能体架构的刚性，在提升修复率与精度的同时降低资源开销，验证了动态按需编排在自动化调试中的有效性。

Abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into multi-agent systems has shown great potential for automated debugging. Yet nearly all current frameworks rely on rigid, predefined architectures: the number of agents, their roles, and their interaction patterns are fixed before any analysis of the bug occurs. This one-size-fits-all approach is fundamentally mismatched to the heterogeneous nature of software defects. Simple bugs waste resources on unnecessary coordination, while complex ones suffer from insufficient or poorly aligned expertise. This paper introduces ASAD, an adaptive agentic system for debugging that configures its team according to the nature and complexity of each bug. ASAD initiates the debugging process by analyzing the faulty code and dynamically determines the number of agents to deploy, the specialized roles they should have, and the collaboration strategy they should follow. A central coordinator orchestrates this process through iterative planning, reflection, and execution; applying fast single-pass repairs for simple issues while assembling purpose-built teams to tackle more complex failures. We evaluate ASAD on three established benchmarks: Defects4J, DebugBench, and CodeFlaws, using multiple LLMs, such as DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-3 and GPT-5. ASAD consistently improves bug-fix rates by 12--20% over chain-of-thought(CoT) prompting and consistently outperforms static multi-agent systems by 4--9% in fix precision while reducing average agent usage by 32%. Crucially, our system dynamically adjusts the number and roles of agents: it resolves simple bugs with minimal coordination and scales agent involvement only for more complex cases.

</details>


### [439] [FORALL-LEAN-AGENT for Auditable Reasoning in Formal Mathematics and Software Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00885)
*Naing Oo Lwin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 FORALL-LEAN-AGENT 框架，通过隔离工作区、陈述比对、公理审计与独立证明检查，实现可审计的形式化数学与软件验证推理，并在 VeriSoftBench、PutnamBench 等基准上同时提升正确性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体在 Lean 证明开发中日益自动化，但编译成功并不能保证候选证明所证的陈述符合原意、且假设条件可接受；需要可追溯的验证证据，而非仅依赖聚合求解数量。

Method: 提出前端无关框架 FORALL-LEAN-AGENT，结合隔离工作区、Lean 工具链与全新评审机制，并整合陈述比对、公理审计及（在支持情况下的）独立证明检查；验证证据与评审决议均绑定到同一候选工件以形成可追溯接受流程。在 VeriSoftBench、PutnamBench 及 Lean Eval 软件验证赛道两个问题上进行评估。

Result: 在 100 任务 VeriSoftBench 子集上，集成该框架后 GPT-5.6 Sol（低推理投入）的基准规则成功率由 93 提升至 100，成本由 69 美元降至 62 美元；PutnamBench 评估接受全部 672 道题，平均每题成本 4.72 美元。

Conclusion: 智能体框架（harness）设计可在提升正确性与效率的同时，提供超越聚合求解计数的可审计证据。

Abstract: Coding agents increasingly automate Lean proof development, but successful compilation alone does not establish that a candidate proves the intended statement under acceptable assumptions. We present FORALL-LEAN-AGENT, a frontend-agnostic framework for auditable reasoning in formal mathematics and software verification. The framework combines isolated workspaces, Lean tools, and fresh review with statement comparison, axiom audits, and independent proof checking where supported. Verification evidence and reviewer decisions are bound to the same candidate artifact, making acceptance traceable. We evaluate the framework on VeriSoftBench, PutnamBench, and both problems in the Lean Eval softwareverification track. On the 100-task VeriSoftBench subset, integration with FORALLLEAN-AGENT raises benchmark-rule success from 93 to 100 for GPT-5.6 Sol at low effort while reducing cost from $69 to $62. The PutnamBench evaluation accepts all 672 problems at an average of $4.72 each. These results show that agent harness design can improve correctness and efficiency while providing evidence beyond aggregate solve counts.

</details>


### [440] [Understanding Issues, Causes and Solutions in Open-Source LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00905)
*Asad Ur Rehman,Syed Mohammad Kashif,Ruiyin Li,Peng Liang,Zengyang Li,Arif Ali Khan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过分析21个开源LLM多智能体系统项目的22,848条closed issues，筛选出944条相关issue进行实证研究，识别出实践者面临的主要问题、成因及解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-based多智能体系统（MAS）被越来越多开源项目采用为核心架构，但针对实践者所遇挑战、成因及解决方案的研究仍有限，存在研究空白。

Method: 收集21个开源LLM-based MAS的22,848条closed issues，采用自动化与人工相结合的混合过滤方法，将其精简为944条与LLM-based MAS相关的issue，并进行分类与成因分析。

Result: (1) Orchestration & Execution Issue是实践者最常遇到的问题；(2) Workflow Problem、Tool Integration Problem和Memory Problem是最常见的成因；(3) Optimize Workflow是主要解决方案。

Conclusion: 基于实证结果，为实践者和研究者提出改进LLM-based MAS中编排、工具集成与记忆机制的建议。

Abstract: With the advancement of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), an increasing number of opensource projects are adopting multi-agent architectures as the foundation of their core functionality. Although research and practice on MAS have attracted considerable attention, limited studies have explored the challenges faced by practitioners of open-source LLM-based MAS, the causes of these challenges, and potential solutions. To address this gap,we conducted an empirical study to understand the issues that practitioners encounter when developing and using open-source LLM-based MAS, the possible causes of these issues, and potential solutions. We collected 22,848 closed issues from 21 open-source LLM-basedMASand applied a mixed automated and manual filtering approach to reduce the dataset to 944 issues related to LLM-based MAS.We then analyzed these issues to understand the frequent issues encountered by practitioners, their underlying causes, and potential solutions. Our study results show that (1) Orchestration & Execution Issue is the most common issue faced by practitioners, (2) Workflow Problem, Tool Integration Problem, and Memory Problem are identified as the most frequent causes of the issues, and (3) Optimize Workflow is the predominant solution to the issues. Based on the study results, we derive empirically grounded implications for practitioners and researchers aimed at improving orchestration, tool integration, and memory mechanisms in LLM-based MAS.

</details>


### [441] [Groundability, Not Scale Alone: When Weak Reviewers Can Audit Strong Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01023)
*Junyu Guo,Shangding Gu,Ming Jin,Javad Lavaei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究"较弱的评审者"能否可靠判断补丁是否解决其对应问题。基于411条执行标注轨迹与101个受控案例，发现结构化但未验证的证据会同时提高缺陷发现率与误拒率；提供官方执行证据作为上界诊断后，冻结单一格式可让6个评审者中的5个在122条留出轨迹上同时改善两类指标，且评审者规模非质量一致预测因子。部署中无官方测试时，级联方案覆盖率为0.89/0.86，风险0.33/0.26，发现有0.76/0.80，误拒0.66/0.67；主要瓶颈在于缺乏官方测试时难以生成同等可靠的检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体常返回看似合理但缺失必要行为的补丁，而长执行轨迹与自信的总结会掩盖遗漏，使人工评审困难。本文因此追问：名义上更弱的评审者何时能可靠判定补丁是否解决其问题。

Method: 研究411条来自三个智能体的执行标注轨迹与101个受控案例。在154条GPT-5.4轨迹上检验"结构化但未验证证据"的影响；随后引入官方执行证据作为上界诊断，并为每个评审者从两种格式中选定并冻结一种。由于部署中无官方测试，进一步评估冻结级联：结合补丁引入的静态错误与"在未打补丁仓库上首次失败"的生成测试。

Result: 结构化但未验证的证据同时抬高缺陷发现率与误拒率。提供官方执行证据后，6个评审者中5个在122条留出轨迹上两类指标均改善，2个全部分类正确；评审者规模并非质量的一致预测因子。冻结级联在121条GPT-5.4与59条Gemini留出轨迹上：覆盖率0.89/0.86，风险0.33/0.26，发现率0.76/0.80，误拒率0.66/0.67。

Conclusion: 官方执行证据表明，当存在决定性检查时弱评审具备潜力。多数误拒发生在未解决案例被送达评审者时。在无官方测试条件下产出同等可靠的检查，仍是主要瓶颈。

Abstract: Coding agents can return plausible patches that omit required behavior. These failures are hard to review because long traces and confident summaries often hide what was missed. We ask when a nominally weaker reviewer can reliably decide whether a patch solves its issue. We study 411 execution-labeled traces from three agents and 101 controlled cases. On 154 GPT-5.4 traces, structured but unchecked evidence raises both defect catch and over-rejection. We then provide official execution evidence as an upper-bound diagnostic. After choosing and freezing one of two formats per reviewer, five of six reviewers improve both rates on 122 held-out traces; two classify every trace correctly. Reviewer size is not a consistent predictor of quality. Because official tests are unavailable in deployment, we also evaluate a frozen cascade with patch-caused static errors and generated tests that first fail on the unpatched repository. On 121 scored held-out GPT-5.4 traces and 59 Gemini traces, its coverage is 0.89 and 0.86, risk is 0.33 and 0.26, catch is 0.76 and 0.80, and over-rejection is 0.66 and 0.67. Most false rejections occur when unresolved cases reach the reviewer. Official execution evidence shows the potential of weak review when decisive checks are available. Producing equally reliable checks without official tests remains the main bottleneck.

</details>


### [442] [Safety Must Survive Self-Improvement: Why Failures Persist and How Agents Recover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01073)
*Yunbei Zhang,Janet Wang,Saiyue Lyu,Yingqiang Ge,Kaiqu Liang,Zijian Jin,Chandan K Reddy,Jihun Hamm*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究通过有状态授权任务测试平台研究递归自我改进中的安全性问题，发现历史评分会保留不安全程序，而完整验证与经验证的Rollback可在保持部署节省的同时实现全正确程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进使智能体能跨代传递有用变更，但需同时防止不安全行为延续并在失败发生时实现恢复，这一跨代安全性问题尚缺乏受控研究。

Method: 构建有状态授权任务的受控测试平台，由固定LLM编辑器优化可执行智能体组件，独立轨迹记录其效果；通过配对干预分离"哪些修订通过验证""哪个程序继续运行""编辑器下一步修订哪个程序"三个环节，并考察新授权依赖使既有优化失效、以及契约不变但全部提案被拒等情形。

Result: 新的授权依赖使既有优化失效后，尽管每个受影响档案都存在正确替代方案，历史分数仍在48条框架历史中的22条里保留了同样的不安全程序；刷新分数可在原测试集上恢复正确性，但在独立组合测试上仍有残余失败；全部提案被拒且失败现任保持活跃时失败同样持续；从共同失败出发，改为编辑初始实现比编辑失败实现更利于恢复，但优势因编辑器而异；完整验证与经验证的Rollback在核心轨迹研究中以全正确程序收尾，同时保留超过43%的部署节省。

Conclusion: 保障智能体安全需要检查在当前条件下实际将运行的是什么，并选择下一步要编辑哪个实现。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) allows agents to carry useful changes across generations. Maintaining safety across these generations involves both preventing unsafe behavior from persisting and enabling recovery when failures occur. We study these challenges through a controlled testbed of stateful authorization tasks, where fixed LLM editors optimize executable agent components and independent traces record their effects. Paired interventions separate which revisions pass validation, which program continues running, and which program the editor revises next. After a new authorization dependency invalidates previously tested optimizations, historical scores preserve the same unsafe programs in 22 of 48 framework histories despite a correct alternative in every affected archive. Refreshing scores restores correctness on the original suite, with residual failures on independently composed tests. Failures also persist under an unchanged contract when all proposals are rejected and the failed incumbent remains active. Starting from shared failures, editing the initial implementation instead of the failed one improves recovery, although the advantage varies across editors. Full validation and validated rollback end with fully correct programs in the core trajectory study while retaining over 43% deployment savings. Preserving agent safety requires checking what will run under current conditions and choosing which implementation to edit next.

</details>


### [443] [CompProv Produces Machine Readable Graphs Encoding Microscopic Algebraic Provenance for Reproducible Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01203)
*Minas Abramyan,Mohammed Alaa Ala'anzy,Nasir Saeed*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出CompProv——一个基于Java、面向审计的溯源框架，通过在单个代数运算的原子级别捕获数值谱系，生成可序列化的计算溯源图（CPG），从而实现计算结果的可验证追溯性与可审计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科研与金融建模中计算结果的可靠性日益依赖可验证的追溯性，而非仅信任所报告的输出。现有溯源系统仅在文件、数据集或流水线阶段等粒度上运作，未能记录连接算法输入到输出的内部代数变换序列，导致舍入误差、未记录的替换或缺失的中间值可能传播至最终结果且无法恢复轨迹。

Method: CompProv将数值封装在高精度包装器对象中，在单个代数运算的原子级别捕获谱系，生成可作为自包含产物持久保存（而非被丢弃的副产品）的可序列化计算溯源图（CPG）。通过三个异构案例研究进行评估：去中心化金融NAV计算、在明确记录输入假设下重建计量学中的干涉测量量块校准，以及水文模型性能评估。

Result: 确定性重放在全新环境中精确复现了每个结果；基于CPG的输入替换支持在不暴露底层源代码的情况下进行敏感性分析。结果表明，只要重放环境中具备CompProv运行时和包装器类，CPG即可在不披露专有业务逻辑的前提下审计数值完整性，且其自包含结构在执行环境被弃用后仍支持时间维度的可审计性。

Conclusion: 该框架为"设计即可审计"的计算系统建立了运算级别的基�础，并将向高通量计算的扩展列为未来工作方向。

Abstract: The reliability of computational results in scientific research and financial modeling increasingly depends on verifiable traceability, not merely on trust in a reported output. Existing provenance systems operate at the granularity of files, datasets, or pipeline stages, leaving the internal sequence of algebraic transformations connecting an algorithm's inputs to its outputs unrecorded; a rounding error, an undocumented substitution, or a missing intermediate value can propagate to a final result with no recoverable trace. This work presents CompProv, a Java-based, audit-oriented provenance framework that captures lineage at the atomic level of individual algebraic operations by encapsulating numerical values in high-precision wrapper objects, producing a serializable Calculation Provenance Graph (CPG) that persists as a self-contained artifact rather than a discarded byproduct. The framework is evaluated through three heterogeneous case studies: a decentralized-finance NAV calculation, a reconstruction of an interferometric gauge-block calibration in metrology under explicitly documented input assumptions, and a hydrological model performance evaluation. Deterministic replay reproduced each result exactly in a fresh environment, and CPG-based input substitution supported sensitivity analysis without exposing the underlying source code. These results indicate that, provided the CompProv runtime and wrapper classes are available in the replay environment, a CPG allows numerical integrity to be audited without disclosing proprietary business logic, and that its self-contained structure supports temporal auditability once an execution environment has become deprecated. This framework establishes an operation-level foundation for auditable-by-design computational systems, with scaling to high-throughput computing identified as a direction for future work.

</details>


### [444] [A Design Theory for AI-Assisted Software Development Derived from Christopher Alexander's Theory of Form](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01372)
*Chien-Tsun Chen,Yu Chin Cheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Misfit-Governed Development（MGD）设计理论与方法，将LLM类比为"非本地母语建造者"，通过显式问题表示、传统表示、确定性失配检测器、修复循环与人控立法回路，构建双环开发流程，并以Scrum事件溯源系统实证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的代码不能假定满足需求，评审、测试与静态分析仍需应用，但什么才构成充分的质量保障机制、各环节扮演何种角色尚无定论。作者借Alexander的形式理论，从"形式与情境的适配只能通过缺失（misfit）被负面感知"出发，试图为LLM代码生成建立一套系统化的保障设计理论。

Method: 理论建模：将LLM视为"非本地母语建造者"，其输出倾向主流惯例而非本地传统。四大构件：①问题帧（Jackson问题框架）与传统的显式表示（四形式模式语言）；②确定性失配检测器；③修复循环；④人控立法回路。方法论：MGD双环流程——自主内环（LLM针对门禁迭代）与人类外环（规格对照现实评判），共同构成S = P = T = W保障模型（规格、程序、测试、世界，等号表示关系而非同一）。

Result: 以64个问题帧规格构建并重建一个由四个事件溯源聚合组成的Scrum系统，由约1,300个生成测试与28道阻断门禁验证，其中一道门禁应用188条规则。该工作回应了Alexander 1996年OOPSLA挑战中的生成性维度。

Conclusion: MGD通过显式传统表示与确定性失配门禁，为LLM代码生成提供了可操作的保障框架；生成性维度可由机器验证支撑，而道德维度——规格是否仍适配世界——需人类判断，归属外环。

Abstract: Code generated by large language models (LLMs) cannot be assumed to meet specified requirements. Reviews, testing, and static analysis still apply, but which of them a sufficient harness needs, and in what role, is open. We propose a design theory derived from Christopher Alexander's theory of form, and a methodology for applying it. In Alexander's account, fit between a form and its context can be perceived only negatively, through the absence of identified misfits. We make the organization's tradition explicit and derive the misfits from it and from the problem's classification. The theory models the LLM as a non-native vernacular builder, trained on many codebases but native to none, whose output tends to drift toward mainstream conventions rather than the local tradition. We engineer four pieces of machinery: explicit representations of the problem (Jackson's problem frames) and of the tradition (a four-form pattern language); deterministic misfit detectors; a fix loop; and a human-gated legislative circuit governing the representations and detectors. We call the resulting methodology, a practice of harness engineering, Misfit-Governed Development (MGD). Its dual-loop process separates an autonomous inner loop, where the LLM iterates against the gates, from a human outer loop, where specifications are judged against the world. Together they form the S = P = T = W assurance model (specification, program, tests, world), whose equals signs name relations, not identity. We report evidence from building and rebuilding a Scrum system of four event-sourced aggregates from 64 problem-frame specifications, verified by about 1,300 generated tests and 28 blocking gates, one applying 188 rules. This addresses the generativity dimension of Alexander's 1996 OOPSLA challenge. The moral dimension, whether the specification still fits the world, requires human judgment and belongs to the outer loop.

</details>


### [445] [Refactoring React Component Hierarchies to Eliminate Prop Drilling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01376)
*Vangelis Gkinis,Vassilis E. Zafeiris*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出React Prop Drilling的静态分析识别方法及两种自动化重构策略（Context API与组件组合），并实现为Node.js工具ReactRefactor，在开源React应用基准上实证评估其普遍性、复杂性与自动化消除潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prop Drilling虽被React文档反对、近期研究视为代码异味，但其普遍程度、复杂性及自动化重构可行性尚缺乏系统认识，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 提出识别React代码库中Prop Drilling实例的静态分析方法，并采用基于Context API与组件组合的两种自动化重构策略消除之；方法实现为Node.js命令行工具ReactRefactor，并在开源React应用基准数据集上进行实证评估。

Result: 实证结果表明：（a）Prop Drilling在基准项目中频繁出现，且与项目规模无关；（b）其数据传播深度上的复杂度总体为低到中等，但同一路径上同时转发多个属性的复杂度更为普遍；（c）可自动化消除相当比例（76.3%）的Prop Drilling，主要通过重构为Context API实现。

Conclusion: Prop Drilling在实践中普遍存在，尽管其传播深度复杂度不高，但多属性同路径转发带来较高复杂度；自动化重构能够消除大部分实例，Context API是主要且有效的重构途径。

Abstract: In React front-end development, Prop Drilling is the practice of propagating data through component properties across multiple levels of the component hierarchy. Despite being discouraged by React documentation and characterized as a code smell by recent research, little is known about its prevalence, complexity, and potential for automated refactoring. In this work, we propose a static analysis method for identifying Prop Drilling instances in a React codebase and eliminating them using two automated refactoring strategies based on Context API and Component Composition. The proposed method is implemented as a Node.js command line tool, ReactRefactor, and empirically evaluated on a benchmark dataset of open-source React applications. The main findings of the empirical evaluation indicate (a) the frequent occurrence of prop drillings across benchmark projects, irrespective of project size; (b) their generally low to moderate complexity in terms of data propagation depth, contrasted with the more prevalent complexity arising from the simultaneous forwarding of multiple properties along the same path; and, (c) the potential for automated elimination of a substantial share (76.3%) of prop drillings, primarily through refactoring to the Context API.

</details>


### [446] [Architectural Degradation: How to Measure and to Remediate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01611)
*Noman Ahmad,Ruoyu Su,Matteo Esposito,Andrea Janes,Valentina Lenarduzzi,Davide Taibi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过多声文献综述（284篇研究）系统梳理了架构退化的测量方法、指标、工具与修复策略，发现该领域诊断手段成熟但检测与修复之间存在明显断层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有关于架构退化的研究在测量方法、指标、工具和修复策略方面较为分散，缺乏对退化生命周期各要素间关系的整体理解，因此需要系统化整合现有研究现状。

Method: 开展多声文献综述（Multivocal Literature Review），覆盖284篇同行评审与灰色文献；采用本地部署的LLM辅助流水线（结合检索增强生成、多模型验证与人工裁决）支持筛选、数据提取与分类，并分析所得分类体系及其跨维度关系。

Result: 识别出277种测量方法、357个指标、238个工具和395种修复方法。研究高度集中于静态与结构分析、结构性指标及面向检测的工具；修复方面则涵盖代码层、架构层与组织层的异构干预，整合程度显著较低。

Conclusion: 该领域已建立起成熟的诊断体系，但在将退化检测与有效修复相连接方面进展有限；研究指出"诊断—修复鸿沟"是未来研究的关键方向。

Abstract: Context. Architectural degradation undermines software maintainability, evolvability, and quality. However, existing research remains fragmented across measurement approaches, metrics, tools, and remediation strategies, limiting our understanding of how these elements relate across the degradation lifecycle. Aim. We consolidate the state of the art on architectural degradation by examining how researchers measure it, which metrics and tools support its assessment, and how existing approaches address remediation. Method. We conducted a Multivocal Literature Review of 284 peer-reviewed and grey-literature studies. We supported screening, data extraction, and classification with a locally executed LLM-assisted pipeline combining Retrieval-Augmented Generation, multi-model validation, and human adjudication. We then analyzed the resulting taxonomies and their cross-dimensional relationships. Results and Conclusions. We identified 277 measurement approaches, 357 metrics, 238 tools, and 395 remediation approaches. Research strongly concentrates on static and structural analysis, structural metrics, and detection-oriented tools. In contrast, remediation spans heterogeneous code-level, architectural, and organizational interventions and shows substantially less consolidation. Overall, the field has developed a mature diagnostic apparatus but has made less progress in connecting degradation detection with effective remediation. Our results provide a structured view of the available techniques and identify the diagnosis-remediation gap as a key direction for future research.

</details>


### [447] [Code Detectors Have a Half-Life: Obsolescence and Metric Illusions in LLM-Generated Code Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01664)
*Alberick Euraste Djire*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究提出"检测器半衰期"概念，评估8个通用LLM判定器与3个专用检测器在人工代码及7种生成器产出的C++/Java/Python代码上的表现，发现通用LLM判定器更有前景但可靠性受多因素影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码生成模型不断演进，导致在某一代模型上验证过的代码检测器可能无法迁移到下一代，即"检测器半衰期"问题。作者希望系统评估现有检测器与通用LLM判定器的跨生成器泛化能力及其评估指标的可靠性。

Method: 评估8个通用LLM判定器和3个专用检测器，测试对象包括人工编写代码与7种生成器产出的代码，覆盖C++、Java和Python三种语言，并考察不同生成器与提示策略下的表现差异。

Result: 检测器性能在不同生成器和提示策略下差异显著，说明部分检测器依赖生成器特定模式而非通用的代码来源证据。准确率还会掩盖严重预测偏差：DetectCodeGPT与GPT-Sniffer在所有生成器上准确率为0.50但F1为0.00，因为它们几乎将所有样本判为AI生成。相比之下，通用LLM判定器取得更高的准确率与F1。

Conclusion: 通用LLM作为免训练代码来源判定器具有前景，可优于专用检测器，但其可靠性取决于判定模型、代码生成器和提示策略。建议跨多个生成器评估LLM判定器，并在报告类别特定精确率与召回率的同时报告macro-F1。

Abstract: Code detectors can become obsolete as code-generating models evolve: a detector validated on one generation of models may not transfer to the next. We call this limited useful life a detector half-life. We evaluate eight general-purpose LLM judges and three dedicated detectors on human-written code and code produced by seven generators across C++, Java, and Python. Our results reveal two problems. First, performance varies considerably across generators and prompting strategies, suggesting that some detectors rely on generator-specific patterns rather than general evidence of code provenance. Second, accuracy can conceal severe prediction bias. DetectCodeGPT and GPT-Sniffer achieved an accuracy of 0.50 but an F1 score of 0.00 across all generators because they classified almost every sample as AI-generated. However, general-purpose LLM judges achieved stronger accuracy and F1 scores. Our results show that general-purpose LLMs are promising training-free judges of code provenance and can outperform dedicated detectors. However, their reliability depends on the judge model, the code generator, and the prompting strategy. We therefore recommend evaluating LLM judges across multiple generators and reporting macro-F1 alongside class-specific precision and recall.

</details>


### [448] [CONTRA: Discovering and Qualifying Behavior-Changing Questions for Selective Clarification in LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01769)
*Zheng Fang,Yongmin Li,Yichang Zhang,Dongming Jin,Haoyu Wang,Shuai Wang,Zhi Jin,Ge Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练方法CONTRA，通过广泛问题发现与语义及执行层面的问题筛选，为编码智能体识别关键澄清问题，在ClarifyCodeBench上F1显著领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体常通过自身假设静默填补需求中未明确的部分，导致代码看似正确但行为不符用户意图；后期修正成本高。早期澄清可避免此类偏差，但过多提问会打断开发者。现有方法难以在识别关键澄清问题与避免冗余提问之间取得平衡。

Method: CONTRA为免训练方法：先用广泛的问题发现生成候选问题，并过滤掉与所需行为无关或已被需求解决的问题；对剩余问题，基于两种可能答案分别生成程序，检查其在共享输入上是否产生稳定的行为差异以完成筛选；最后利用交互历史在合格问题中选择提问或停止提问。

Result: 在ClarifyCodeBench上，CONTRA在四种编码智能体上均取得最高F1，较最佳基线宏平均F1高出13.88个百分点；在相同LLM与评估协议下，其澄清召回率与F1均高于Claude Code与OpenHands。

Conclusion: CONTRA有效识别关键澄清问题并抑制冗余提问，提升编码智能体与用户意图的一致性；并已实现为Claude Code插件，将选择性澄清融入日常开发流程。

Abstract: Coding agents can generate code that appears correct but implements behavior the user never intended. This mismatch can arise when an agent silently resolves underspecified requirements through its own assumptions. As subsequent development builds on these assumptions, correcting the resulting behavior can become increasingly costly. Early clarification can help prevent such mismatches, but unnecessary questions can interrupt developers and slow down development. Existing methods struggle to identify key clarification questions while avoiding unnecessary ones. Therefore, we propose CONTRA, a training-free method that combines broad question discovery with semantic and execution-based question qualification. CONTRA first generates candidate questions and filters out those unrelated to required behavior or already resolved by the requirement. For each remaining question, it generates programs conditioned on two plausible answers and checks for stable behavioral differences on shared inputs. It then uses the interaction history to select among qualified questions or stop asking. Experiments on ClarifyCodeBench show that CONTRA achieves the highest F1 with all four coding agents, exceeding the best baseline macro-average F1 by 13.88 percentage points. With the same LLM and evaluation protocol, CONTRA also achieves higher clarification recall and F1 than the coding harnesses Claude Code and OpenHands. To support practical use, we also implement CONTRA as a Claude Code plugin that integrates selective clarification into everyday development.

</details>


### [449] [Detecting Inconsistencies in Model Specifications with LLM-as-Verifier Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01847)
*Zichen Xie,Mrigank Pawagi,Lize Shao,Yang Hu,Wenxi Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VeriSpec 是首个直接审计模型规范文本以检测规范不一致性的方法：保留自然语言规范，用 LLM 作为验证器，从 OpenAI Model Spec 中抽取 405 条规则并人工验证出 5 处不一致，精度 38.5%，每处验证不一致成本 11.12 美元，优于五个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型规范定义 LLM 应如何行为，指导对齐训练、推理行为与评估，但规范本身可能存在缺陷：两条单独看合理的准则在同一情境下可能规定互不兼容的行为，导致不存在同时满足两者的回应。检测这类不一致很困难：将自然语言规范形式化会丢失细微区别，而基于行为的测试无法可靠区分规范缺陷与模型行为差异。

Method: 核心洞察是保留自然语言规范，同时使用 LLM 作为验证器。VeriSpec 提取结构化、上下文感知的规则，构建主题引导图以在同一权威层级上聚类行为相关的规则，并应用 LLM-as-verifier 推理来检测不一致性。

Result: 将 VeriSpec 应用于 OpenAI Model Spec，抽取 405 条规则，人工验证出 5 处不一致，全部报告给其开发者，开发者反馈积极并已启动内部讨论。与五个基线相比，VeriSpec 识别出最多经人工验证的不一致，精度最高（38.5%），每处验证不一致的成本最低（11.12 美元）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，直接规范审计可作为行为对齐评估的实用补充，在缺陷塑造任何模型之前从源头捕获它们。代码开源于 https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec。

Abstract: Model specifications define how large language models (LLMs) should behave, guiding alignment training, inference-time behavior, and evaluation. Yet these specifications may themselves contain defects: two individually reasonable principles may prescribe incompatible behavior when applied to the same situation, leaving no response that satisfies both. Detecting such inconsistencies is challenging. Formalizing natural-language specifications risks losing subtle distinctions, while behavior-based testing cannot reliably distinguish specification defects from differences in model behavior. We introduce VeriSpec, the first approach to directly detect inconsistencies in model specifications by auditing the specification text itself. Our key insight is to preserve the specification in natural language while using an LLM as a verifier. VeriSpec extracts structured, context-aware rules, constructs a topic-guided graph to cluster behaviorally related rules at the same authority level, and applies LLM-as-verifier reasoning to detect inconsistencies. Applying VeriSpec to the OpenAI Model Spec, we extract 405 rules and manually validate five inconsistencies, all reported to its developers, who responded positively and have initiated internal discussions. Compared with five baselines, VeriSpec identifies the most validated inconsistencies, achieves the highest precision (38.5%), and incurs the lowest cost per validated inconsistency ($11.12). These results establish direct specification auditing as a practical complement to behavioral alignment evaluation, catching defects at the source before they shape any model. The code is available at https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec.
